该主板很可能起到了神经中枢的作用，促进科腐者的通讯网络。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
This twisted husk barely resembles the electronic device it once was, consumed and reshaped by the Techrot’s relentless spread.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
这个扭曲的外壳已经不再像曾经的电子设备，它被科腐者的无情蔓延所吞噬并重塑。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
Höllvanian ingenuity knows no bounds, and this unregulated marvel is proof! A cutting-edge device brimming with untamed innovation.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
霍瓦尼亚人的创造力是无穷的，这个不受管制的奇迹就是证明！一款充满狂野创新的尖端设备。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
The Countessa isn't just an icon—she's a hero! Issues from this cult classic comic series are sought after by subculture enthusiasts who know the value of a strong and stylish protagonist. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
伯爵夫人不仅仅是一个偶像——她还是一个英雄！这个经典邪典漫画系列的期刊，深受亚文化爱好者的追捧，他们知道强大而时尚的主角的价值。与莱蒂交换这个六人组宝物，以获取六人组声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
The ultimate gift for fans of On-lyne! Show your love and support with this must-have merch for any music lover's collection. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
这是送给线上时代粉丝的终极礼物！用这款必备商品来表达你的热爱和支持，它是任何音乐爱好者的收藏品。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
A set of liquid comfort perfect for anyone who deserves a moment to unwind. Ideal for someone carrying the weight of the world on their shoulders. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
一套液体放松饮品，非常适合那些肩负世界重担、需要片刻喘息的人。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
Sleek, stylish, and soothing, mood crystals are the perfect gift for anyone in need of a little calm. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
心情水晶造型时尚、美观且令人放松，是送给需要冷静一点的人的完美礼物。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
A nostalgic treat for the ultimate ‘90s kid! Remember those commercials with the cheerful mouse quartet? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
这是送给 90 年代孩子的怀旧礼物！还记得那些有欢快的老鼠四重奏的广告吗？用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
For the documentarian who sees the world through a unique lens, extra film is always a win. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
对于对世界有独特视角的纪录片制作人来说，影片越多越好。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
Who doesn't like pizza? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
谁不喜欢披萨？用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
Burgers so tasty they always disappear!

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
descriptions.zh:
汉堡美味可口，总是一扫而光！

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

descriptions.en:
The manifestation of Thrax's malevolence that shapes the Orowyrms' outbursts.

Location: Rewarded upon defeating the Orowyrm in Duviri
descriptions.zh:
士魂大帝恶念的显化之物，塑造了奥金魇龙的情绪爆发。

获取地点：在双衍王境击败奥金魇龙后获得的奖励

descriptions.en:
Its power lies in its potential.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
它的力量在于它的潜能。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
A whisper of the fallen.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
亡者的低语。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
Rune Marrow erupts from Duviri’s core.

Location: The Undercroft in Duviri
descriptions.zh:
密印髓质从双衍王境的核心中喷出。

获取地点：双衍王境地穴

descriptions.en:
Kullervo's fury incarnate. Acrithis will trade this prized artifact for certain items from her collection.

Location: Earned by confronting Kullervo and defeating the Orowyrm in the same Duviri mission during the Fear, Anger, or Sorrow spiral
descriptions.zh:
Kullervo 的愤怒化身。可以用这件珍贵的神器与言录使换取她收藏的某些物品。 

获取地点：在恐惧、愤怒或悲伤复眠螺旋中对抗 Kullervo 并在同一个双衍王境任务中打败奥金魇龙

descriptions.en:
Duviri citizens plagued by nightmares seek Tasoma, because its stalks can be crushed to create juice that invites pleasant dreams. Unfortunately, it is difficult to forage Tasoma as it only grows in caves.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
被噩梦缠身的双衍王境公民们找寻塔苏摩，因为将它的茎压榨后可以制成带来美梦的果汁。但遗憾的是，塔苏摩只生长于洞穴，因此很难被找到。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en: A Tasoma fungal spore, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
descriptions.zh: 一种塔苏摩真菌孢子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

descriptions.en:
Duviri citizens harvest Kovnik leaves to blend invigorating teas.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
双衍王境的公民们采集福烁草叶子来调配提神茶。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
Duviri citizens have been known to mash Eevani leaves into a paste that alleviates the discomfort caused by fresh wounds.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
据说双衍王境的居民会把延凡草的叶子捣碎成糊状，来缓解新伤口引起的不适。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
The water that courses through Connla Sprouts tastes sweet and refreshing.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
流经慧泉嫩芽的水尝起来甜美清新。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
The warm light of the Yao Shrub glows even within cold dark places.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
瑶丛即使在寒冷阴暗的地方也能散发温暖的光亮。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
It is traditionally held that to see Silphsela floating in the air heralds an imminent change in the sky.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
传统上认为，看到日精灵瘦果漂浮在空中预示着天空即将发生变化。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
Dracroot is a staple of the Wyrmling’s diet.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
龙旋根是魇龙幼体的主食。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
Ueymag meat is said to be delicious. Just mind the barbs.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
据说肉麦的肉很好吃。但需小心其倒刺。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
Thrax warriors use the heavy liquid drawn from Saggen Wells to polish their weapons.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
士魂大帝的战士们使用从慧珠之泉提取出来的重质液体来擦拭他们的武器。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en:
A token celebrating the successful solution of a Duviri Enigma.

Location: Earned by completing Enigmas in The Duviri Experience
descriptions.zh:
庆祝成功破解双衍王境奥理的纪念物。

获取地点：在双衍历程中完成奥理

descriptions.en:
It is said that Aggri Formations are hardened saliva from mighty Orowyrms. Duviri citizens believe Aggristones are powerful talismans.

Location: Duviri
descriptions.zh:
据说龙涎结晶是来自强大奥金魇龙的硬化唾液。双衍居民们相信龙涎石是强大的护身符。

获取地点：双衍王境

descriptions.en: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
descriptions.zh: 有些理论认为，双衍王境坐落在一只巨大的载世龟壳上。自然而然地，一些人会想知道巨大的载世龟是站在什么之上的。答案当然是其他载世龟，一个接一个叠到底部。

descriptions.en: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
descriptions.zh: 黄金喉兽发现息壤鲳特别美味。

descriptions.en: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
descriptions.zh: 浮伤鱼喜欢在靠近水面的地方游。双衍王境的公民经常把它们误认为木头，当浮伤鱼露出它们的尖牙时，可能会让人大吃一惊。

descriptions.en: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
descriptions.zh: 纳土鲉已经进化出收紧尾部肌肉的能力，并把它的尾巴当成一种可怕的武器。

descriptions.en: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
descriptions.zh: 精灵鱼的颈部和头鳍可以伸展，让大多数的捕食者无法吞咽，但是黄金喉兽可以攻克它的防御。

descriptions.en:
Collectors like to marvel at the peculiar origin of Nacreous Pebbles. Their beauty is the result of ordinary pebbles having been ingested and regurgitated by the Golden Maw.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
descriptions.zh:
收藏家们喜欢惊叹于珍珠母石的特殊来源。它们的美丽是普通鹅卵石被黄金喉兽吞食和反刍的结果。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽

descriptions.en:
Each Duviri fish species has distinct features, but they all evolved beautiful chromatic scales.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
descriptions.zh:
每一种双衍王境鱼类都具有与众不同的特征，但它们都进化产生了美丽的彩色鳞片。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽

descriptions.en:
Looks like someone got carried away during a delicious meal.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
descriptions.zh:
看起来有人在一顿美餐中被冲昏了头脑。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽

descriptions.en:
The dust of decayed universes, rich in entropy. Entrati's research postulates it as the animating agent of the nightmarish Murmur.

Obtained from Murmur in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
descriptions.zh:
衰变宇宙的尘埃，富含熵。英择谛的研究推测，它正是如噩梦一般的低语者的驱动力。

在《织屿人》任务（双衍王境）中从低语者处获得

descriptions.en:
A remnant of battle with Oraxia, the spider that once wore this skin is gone… though it is not easy to tell where.

Obtained by defeating Oraxia in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
descriptions.zh:
与 Oraxia 战斗留下的残骸，曾经穿着这外壳的蜘蛛已经不见了……然而它的去向不得而知。

在《织屿人》任务（双衍王境）中击败 Oraxia 获得

descriptions.en:
Stolen golden seals emblematic of royal authority in Duviri. Return them to restore Dominus Thrax to the throne.

Obtained by completing Isleweaver missions in Duviri during Operation: Eight Claw
descriptions.zh:
被盗的金印，象征双衍王境的王权。归还它们，让士魂大帝重回王位。

可通过在《行动代号：八爪》期间完成双衍王境的《织屿人》任务获得

descriptions.en:
The talon on a condroc's wing is sharp enough to tear through bone.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
秃鹰翅膀上的利爪可以伤至见骨。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

descriptions.en:
Most common at night, these stone lifeforms are drawn to shorelines touched by the Eidolon. They linger around lakes on the Plains of Eidolon at all hours. Their origin remains mysterious.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这些最常出没于夜晚的岩石生命体会被夜灵所触及的海岸线所吸引。它们随时都在夜灵平野的湖泊周围徘徊。它们的起源仍然是个谜。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

descriptions.en:
This hardy fruit is thick-skinned to withstand harsh conditions, concealing a mouthful of sweet pulp within.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种顽强的植物有着坚硬的外皮以抵抗严峻的环境，将饱满的甜美果肉隐藏在其中。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

descriptions.en:
The sinew from the Kuaka's spinal claws can be tanned to make resilient and flexible leather.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
从库阿卡的脊爪上取得的肌腱，可以晒制成既强韧且具弹性的皮革。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

descriptions.en:
A noxious mix of polysaccharides and long-chain polymers, Grokdrul is a standard chemical used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
多醣类与长链聚合物的有毒混合物，葛克度是标准的 Grineer 工业化学材料。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

descriptions.en:
A mineral valuable to the Ostrons.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
一种对 Ostron 人很有价值的矿物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

descriptions.en:
Used by the Nistlebrush to trap and kill prey.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
尼蒐丛用它来困住并杀死猎物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

descriptions.en:
An integral component of Sentient anatomy.  Rarely found undamaged, the specimen may prove useful.

Location: Drops from Vomvalysts on the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) at night, and from Sentients found on Lua and the Veil Proxima
descriptions.zh:
Sentient 解剖结构中不可或缺的部分。这种难得完好无损的样本可能有重要用途。

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚由轰击使掉落，并且在月球与面纱比邻星域由 Sentient 掉落

descriptions.en:
A Sentient Core of this quality and condition has rarely been found. Truly a special specimen.

Location: Earned by capturing Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
descriptions.zh:
这种品质和状态的 Sentient 核心极为罕见。真正的特殊样本。

获取地点：通过捕获在地球夜间的夜灵平野漫游的夜灵获得

descriptions.en:
A coveted sample of Sentient internal anatomy. Specimens of this age and quality are both rare and valuable. 

Location: Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
descriptions.zh:
令人垂涎的 Sentient 内部解剖样本。这种年份和品质的样本既稀有又珍贵。 

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚中漫游的夜灵

descriptions.en: Combine multiple Rivens to create a new, different Riven.
descriptions.zh: 将多个裂罅 MOD 组合起来创造出一个新的不同的裂罅 MOD。

descriptions.en:
Torn from the bile duct of a fallen Hemocyte.

Location: Hemocytes found in Plague Star event Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon on Earth
descriptions.zh:
从死亡的免疫血胞体胆管上剥落的物质。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）上的瘟疫之星活动赏金任务中的免疫血胞体

descriptions.en: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus or to unbind Way-bound focus nodes.
descriptions.zh: 通过捕获在夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获得专精点数，或解锁绑定的专精节点。

descriptions.en: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus.
descriptions.zh: 通过捕获在夜间中徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获取专精点数。

descriptions.en: Shard gained from the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night.
descriptions.zh: 从夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 身上所取得的碎片。

descriptions.en: A curious blueprint found in the memory banks of Albrecht Entrati's Pom-2.
descriptions.zh: 在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的石榴 2 代电脑系统记忆中发现的奇特蓝图。

descriptions.en:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
descriptions.zh:
这个诅咒包含了能帮助斐波那契阻止敌人逃离圣所的知识。将诅咒交给你们氏族道场的形态合成兽像，以重新调整其防御能力。

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
descriptions.zh:
这个诅咒包含了能帮助斐波那契阻止敌人逃离圣所的知识。将诅咒交给你们氏族道场的形态合成兽像，以重新调整其防御能力。

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
descriptions.zh:
这个诅咒包含了能帮助斐波那契阻止敌人逃离圣所的知识。将诅咒交给你们氏族道场的形态合成兽像，以重新调整其防御能力。

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
A foreboding fragment of the vast Indifference.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
descriptions.zh:
巨大虚空无情之物的不祥碎片。

地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
A Voidtongue cry, trapped in the stone. Crucial to unraveling the secrets of the Murmur.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
被封印在石头里的虚空语叫声，对解开低语者的秘密至关重要。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
The quietest and most elusive of Voidtongue utterances. Sought after but never found by Albrecht.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
虚空语中最安静、最难以捉摸的话语。阿尔布雷希特一直在寻找却从未找到。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
The deepest of Voidtongue moans, etched into stone. An unlikely asset in the construction of Albrecht's vessels.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
被刻进石头中的深沉的虚空语哀鸣。意外地成为了一种建造阿尔布雷希特的承载体的资源。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
During the Orokin era, these obols were a commonly recognized mark of the Entrati family. Some Archimedeans even used them as good luck talismans.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
在奥罗金时代，这些小硬币是英择谛家族公认的标志。一些哲士甚至把它们当作幸运护身符。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
This experimental array transmutes Void energy into high voltages with low currents.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
这个实验阵列将虚空能量转化为带有低电流的高电压。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos) and Zariman
descriptions.zh:
用于将虚空地点映射到真实空间的仪式信标。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）和扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
This Void-touched stone contains an ominous essence.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
这块虚空之石蕴含着不祥的本质。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
A crucial sub-component in the construction of Albrecht Entrati's vessels.

Obtained from Disruption missions on Armatus, Deimos.
descriptions.zh:
一个阿尔布雷希特·英择谛承载体建造中的关键子部件。

通过完成火卫二卫城区上的中断任务获得。

descriptions.en:
Eris, carved up and presented to Praghasa in bite sized chunks.

Obtained from Infested nodes on Eris during Epoch Operation: Taubound.
descriptions.zh:
被切成小块献给「布拉喀萨」的阋神星。

在《划时代行动：奔赴 Tau 星系》期间，从阋神星上的 Infested 节点获得。

descriptions.en:
These scarce, hovering relics of the Orokin era can still be found monitoring the isolation vaults deep beneath the surface of Deimos.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
descriptions.zh:
这些罕见的奥罗金时代的悬浮遗迹，仍旧监视着火卫二地底深处的隔离库。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
Half-formed, incomplete spore bearers, little more than twitching flesh with claws to latch on with.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
descriptions.zh:
半成型的不完整孢子载体，只是一个会用利爪固定自己的抽搐着的肉块。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
A fallen clump of entangled nerve fibers, redundant organs, and thin sensory membranes.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
descriptions.zh:
一团由缠绕在一起的神经纤维、无用器官以及感官薄膜组成的簇体。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
The damaged remains of a Necramech supporting frame.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift, and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
descriptions.zh:
殁世机甲支撑框架的残骸，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 外壳

descriptions.en:
An engine designed for use in a Necramech. Unfortunately, it's damaged.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
descriptions.zh:
为殁世机甲设计的引擎。遗憾的是，它处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 引擎

descriptions.en:
A modular component for a Necramech. It's damaged and in need of repair.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
descriptions.zh:
殁世机甲的模块组件。它处于损坏状态，需要修复。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 机舱

descriptions.en:
A broken weapon system intended for a Necramech.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
descriptions.zh:
为殁世机甲设计的武器系统，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 武器舱

descriptions.en:
The damaged barrel of a heavy-duty Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
descriptions.zh:
重型殁世机甲武器的枪管，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金和奥秘隔离库赏金、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪管

descriptions.en:
A broken frame that can be used in the construction of a Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
descriptions.zh:
可以用来构建殁世机甲武器的框架部件，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金和奥秘隔离库赏金、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪机

descriptions.en:
The fractured back portion of a large Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
descriptions.zh:
大型殁世机甲武器的后部，处于断裂状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金和奥秘隔离库赏金、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪托

descriptions.zh: 一个殁世机甲武器的制作部件。

descriptions.en:
A spatial orientation matrix to aid with a mechs' guidance, balance and movement.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 1 Isolation Vault Bounties
descriptions.zh:
一个用来辅助机甲制导、平衡，以及移动的空间定位矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 1 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人

descriptions.en:
A cognition matrix that enables mechs to be adaptable and efficient in the field.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 3 Isolation Vault Bounties
descriptions.zh:
一个让机甲在战场上具备适应性和高效率的认知矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 3 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人

descriptions.en:
A mech matrix that assists with the machine's weapon accuracy and control.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 2 Isolation Vault Bounties
descriptions.zh:
一个用来辅助机甲武器精准度和操控性的机甲矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 2 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人

descriptions.en:
These orbs have long since fulfilled their original function, but still, thrum with faint power.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
descriptions.zh:
这些球体早已完成了它们最初的使命，但它们依然剩下微弱的能量。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
Highly charged particles of pure energy. The source of the Jade Light, and Jade's power. Highly coveted by Parvos Granum for his Jade Eximus program.

Obtained from Operation Ascension missions (Brutus on Uranus) and special Operation Alerts during Operation: Belly of the Beast.
descriptions.zh:
由纯能量组成的高度带电粒子。这些粒子是翠玉之光及 Jade 力量的来源，帕尔沃斯·格拉努为了他的翠玉卓越者项目非常渴求这些粒子。

通过完成行动扬升任务（天王星的布鲁图斯）和《行动代号：兽之腹》的特殊行动警报获得。

descriptions.en:
Remnants of Jade's light. Echoes of her power.

Obtained from Ascension missions on Brutus, Uranus.
descriptions.zh:
Jade 之光的残留。她力量的回响。

通过完成天王星布鲁图斯节点上的扬升任务获得。

descriptions.en: A source of anti-entropic radiation ideal for empowering synthetic lifeforms, most notably Archons and Warframes.
descriptions.zh: 一种反熵辐射来源，用于强化合成生命体，尤其是执刑官和战甲。

descriptions.en:
The ragged remnants of hopes and dreams can be recreated with patient persistence.

Obtained by completing Follie's Hunt missions on Vesper Relay and Nightmare missions during Operation: Atramentum.
descriptions.zh:
希望与梦想的残缺碎片，终能通过耐心与坚持重获新生。

通过在《行动代号：墨痕》期间完成 Vesper 中继站的 Follie 的狩猎任务和噩梦任务获得。

descriptions.en:
This deep black ink has the power to reveal hidden truth.

Obtained from Atramentum Balloons and completing Follie's Hunt missions (Vesper Relay). Exchanged with Aspirant Zorba in any Relay.
descriptions.zh:
这种深黑色的墨水拥有揭示隐藏真相的力量。

通过墨痕气球，以及完成 Follie 的狩猎任务获得（Vesper 中继站）。前往任意中继站，在见习仲裁者左巴处使用墨痕兑换物品。

descriptions.en:
The passionate heat of flames fuels the path to redemption.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
descriptions.zh:
炽热的火焰点燃了救赎之路。

获取地点：从沉沦之地（深溯池）的箱子和头目处获得。

descriptions.en:
A core of rage, jealously guarded in a burnished shell.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
descriptions.zh:
愤怒的核心，被小心翼翼地守护在光洁的外壳之下。

获取地点：从沉沦之地（深溯池）的箱子和头目处获得。

descriptions.en:
The evolved core of a Dactolyst, bearing its true self-given name and identity. When deprived of Tau pollen, the core becomes susceptible to forcible reprogramming.

Obtained from Recall: Dactolyst missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
descriptions.zh:
这是指节使进化后的核心，承载着其真正自创的名字和身份。当 Tau 花粉供给中断时，这个核心就容易被强制重编程。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：指节使'任务中获取。

descriptions.en:
A delicate paraneural interface allowing a duly evolved Sentient pilot to command the colossal Hunhullus as if it were a second skin.

Obtained from Recall: Hunhullus missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory)
descriptions.zh:
一种精妙的外神经接口，使经过适当进化的 Sentient 飞行员能够像操控第二层皮肤一样操控庞大的英魂统使。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：英魂统使'任务中获取。

descriptions.en:
Technology developed by Executor Ballas to allow remote piloting of a hijacked Warframe for short periods, forcing them to act against even their deepest instincts.

Obtained from Recall: Vanguard missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
descriptions.zh:
由执行者 Ballas 开发的技术，可对被劫持的战甲进行短时间的远程操控，迫使他们违背自己最深层的本能行事。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：先锋'任务中获取。

descriptions.en:
A mark of identification carried by soldiers during The Old War so that their names might be remembered if they never returned home.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).
descriptions.zh:
这是远古之战时期士兵携带的身份标记，以便在他们无法返回家乡时，人们能够记住他们的名字。

获取地点：在佩里塔叛乱任务（深溯池）中的箱子和敌人处获得。

descriptions.en:
Awarded by Grand Carnus Roathe in recognition of valorous deeds past and present.

Obtained from Perita Rebellion (Dark Refractory) and Operation Alerts during Operation: Blood of Perita.
Exchange with Roathe after completing The Old Peace Quest.
descriptions.zh:
由总司令罗瑟授予，以表彰其过去和现在的英勇事迹。

可通过《行动代号：佩里塔之血》期间的佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）和行动警报获得。
完成《旧日和平》系列任务后，可用来与罗瑟兑换。

descriptions.en:
Medals awarded to Orokin soldiers during The Old War for acts of distinguished service.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).
descriptions.zh:
在远古之战期间授予奥罗金士兵表彰杰出功绩的勋章。

获取地点：在佩里塔叛乱任务（深溯池）中的箱子和敌人处获得。

descriptions.en:
Awarded to soldiers during the The Old War for distinction in battle.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).
descriptions.zh:
远古之战期间授予在战斗中表现优异的士兵的物品。

获取地点：在佩里塔叛乱任务（深溯池）中的箱子和敌人处获得。

descriptions.en:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Crisma Toroids by defeating the Profit-Taker Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

通过击败金星奥布山谷的利润收割者圆蛛来获取圣油环型装置。

descriptions.en:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Lazulite Toroids by defeating the Exploiter Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

通过击败金星奥布山谷的剥削者圆蛛来获取天蓝环型装置。

descriptions.en:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Calda Toroids from enemies located at the Enrichment Labs in the Orb Vallis and from Scyto Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷升华实验室内的敌人那里和赛托蛛形机那里获取告达环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。

descriptions.en:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Vega Toroids from enemies located at the Spaceport in the Orb Vallis and from Mite Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷航天站内的敌人那里和微螨蛛形机那里获取维加环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。

descriptions.en:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Sola Toroids from enemies located at the Temple of Profit in the Orb Vallis and from Kyta Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷润盈殿内的敌人那里和凯塔蛛形机那里获取索拉环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。

descriptions.en:
A by-product from the Weeping Towers terraforming processes.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
descriptions.zh:
地球化改造过程中渗流之塔的一种副产物。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

descriptions.en:
A modular component that regulates latitude and altitude in various Corpus systems. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
descriptions.zh:
一种可以在各种 Corpus 系统中调节纬度和高度的模组部件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得

descriptions.en:
A modular component that compensates for the multitude of atmospheric conditions encountered in the Origin System. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
descriptions.zh:
一种可以抵消在始源星系中遇到的许多大气条件的模组部件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得

descriptions.en:
Anti-gravity system that allows massively heavy objects to be manipulated by a single user. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
descriptions.zh:
反重力系统可以让一名使用者单独操控沉重的物件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得。

descriptions.en:
A fungal body prized for its varied uses.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种真菌体，因其用途广泛而备受推崇。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

descriptions.en: These Orokin devices emerge when the floating glaciers impact on the surface of Venus. Their purpose is unknown.
descriptions.zh: 这些奥罗金设备会在漂浮的冰川撞击地面时出现。它们的目的未知。

descriptions.en:
The reproductive spore of the giant Vallis fungi is highly coveted for the complex chemical compounds it contains.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种山谷巨大菌类的生殖孢子由于其包含的复杂化合物而令人垂涎。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

descriptions.en: Engineered by the Orokin to convert airborne chemicals into breathable air.
descriptions.zh: 由奥罗金设计将大气中的化学物质转化为可呼吸的空气。

descriptions.en:
The iridescent nodules on these plants glow brightly in cold environments.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这些植物上色彩斑斓的结瘤在寒冷的环境中发出明亮的光辉。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

descriptions.en:
A unique variant of Thrax Plasm harvested during Void Conjunctions on Lua.

Location: Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua
descriptions.zh:
一种独特的凶魂浆质变体，可在月球上的虚空联结期间收获。

获取地点：月球的 Yuvarium 和 Circulus

descriptions.en:
A dangerous and erratic type of Kuva.

Obtained from Entropic Eximus in Zariman missions.
descriptions.zh:
一种危险且不稳定的赤毒。

在扎里曼任务中从熵之卓越者获得。

descriptions.en:
A Void Angel's living feather, ripped out in combat.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
一根来自虚空天使的鲜活羽毛，在战斗中被扯了下来。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
Found in the remnants of Thrax Void manifestations, this plasm has several surprisingly practical applications.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
在凶魂虚空显化者的遗骸中找到，这种浆质有一些令人惊讶的实际效用。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A symbol of genius, fallen from Void Angels long ago.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
天才的象征，很久以前就从虚空天使身上掉落了。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
Barbed and half-real, shed by a Void Angel.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
带刺且半真实，从一位虚空天使脱落。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
The fine plumes from a Void Angel's crown.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
虚空天使王冠上的精美羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A metallic plume from a Void Angel's wing.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
虚空天使翅膀上的一片金属羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A sample of ambient Void energy distilled into a neutral state.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
一个包含了周围环境中虚空能量的样本，蒸馏成了中性状态。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos) and Zariman
descriptions.zh:
用于将虚空地点映射到真实空间的仪式信标。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）和扎里曼号

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle in a Techrot-choked Mall beneath Höllvania. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在充满了科腐者的霍瓦尼亚商场地底模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle in the back-alleys of Höllvania. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在霍瓦尼亚后巷中模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

names.zh: 霍瓦尼亚庭院幻影装置

descriptions.en: A new arena for the Simulacrum. Who will you invite to dance?
descriptions.zh: 一个全新的幻影装置场地。你会邀请谁共舞？

descriptions.en: The standard Simulacrum arena.
descriptions.zh: 标准的幻影装置场地。

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle in the deepest depths of a tormented mind. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在饱受折磨的心灵深处模拟一场战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle straight out of Tales of Duviri. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 模拟一场《双衍王境故事集》中的战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置成高于标准最大值 25 级。

names.zh: 奥金魇龙角斗场幻影装置

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle in the Sanctum Anatomica. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.

descriptions.en: Stage a battle in your enemy's arena for deeper insight into their tactics. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在敌人的竞技场中上演一场战斗，深入了解他们的战术。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

descriptions.en: Step into your opponent's territory to devise a strategy for their defeat. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 踏入对手的领地，制定击败他们的战略。此模拟允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle inside an Orokin Derelict. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在奥罗金遗迹中模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle on your foe's terrain. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在敌人的地形上模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

names.zh: 智踱恐鸟竞技场幻影装置

descriptions.en: Hone your combat skills under the auspices of the Red Veil. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在血色面纱的庇护下磨炼你的战斗技能。此模拟允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

names.zh: 血色面纱神庙幻影装置

descriptions.en: Simulate a battle under the light of Lua. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
descriptions.zh: 在月球的光辉下模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

descriptions.en:
Otak is grateful for your aid. This helps him to remember it.

Obtained from Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
descriptions.zh:
奥塔十分感激你的帮助。这将有助于他牢记这点。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）奥塔处获得。

descriptions.en:
A mark of Son's respect for services rendered.

Obtained from Son in the Necralisk on Deimos.
descriptions.zh:
一枚印记，象征'儿子'对于所受到的帮助，表示的敬意。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）'儿子'处获得。

descriptions.en:
A token of Daughter's gratitude.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk on Deimos.
descriptions.zh:
一枚印记，象征着'女儿'的感激。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）'女儿'处获得。

descriptions.en:
A rare sign of Grandmother's favor.

Obtained from Grandmother in the Necralisk on Deimos.
descriptions.zh:

从殁世幽都（火卫二）'祖母'处获得。

descriptions.en:
A symbol of Father's trust and confidence.

Obtained from Father in the Necralisk on Deimos.
descriptions.zh:
一枚印记，代表着'父亲'的信任与信赖。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）'父亲'处获得。

descriptions.en:
A mark of Mother's esteem.

Obtained by completing Bounties in the Cambion Drift on Deimos.
descriptions.zh:
一枚印记，代表着'母亲'的敬重。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）'母亲'处获得。

descriptions.en:
This refined toxin catalyst has been formulated to reinforce the Thrax Toxin and maximize damage to the Infested boil in Plague Star bounties.

Location: Bio Lab in Clan Dojo
descriptions.zh:
这种精制毒素催化剂的配方，可强化瑟拉斯毒素，并在《瘟疫之星》赏金任务中最大限度地提高对感染疖瘤产生的伤害。

获取地点：氏族道场的生物实验室

descriptions.en:
Sentient immunity to the Infestation is exploited with this refined phylaxis. Formulated specifically to combat Infested boils in Plague Star bounties.

Location: Nakak's Operational Supply in Cetus
descriptions.zh:
利用 Sentient 对感染者的免疫力所制作的精制抗体。专为对付《瘟疫之星》赏金任务中的侵染疖瘤而配制。

获取地点：希图斯上娜卡处的行动补给

descriptions.en:
Used to locate the Ambulas production facility.

This resource is dropped from Ambulas Units.
descriptions.zh:
用来定位量产智踱恐鸟的设施。

该资源由智踱恐鸟单位掉落。

descriptions.en: Battle pay for Tenno fighting in Operation Scarlet Spear.
descriptions.zh: 为在《行动代号：猩红之矛》中作战的 Tenno 准备的报酬。

descriptions.en:
Many Deimos fish secrete reagents in a pouchlike organ, creating volatile gases that enable limited periods of levitation. 

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Cryptosuctus
Barbisteo
Kymaeros
Amniophysi
Glutinox
descriptions.zh:
许多火卫二的鱼类会在类似囊状的器官中分泌液体来产生挥发性气体，从而实现短暂的悬浮。

来源：通过在殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
墓沼隐龙
倒刺蒂鳌
高额异鳍
针刺长鳄
狍鸮胶蛳

descriptions.en:
Adaptive membranes allow many Deimos fish to move freely between fluid and gaseous environments.

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Myxostomata
Duroid
descriptions.zh:
自适应膜可使许多火卫二的鱼类在液体和气体环境之间自由移动。

来源：在殁世幽都（火卫二）中的'女儿'处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
独角米索鳎
韧铠灵鲷

descriptions.en:
The Infestation infects all fish on Deimos, even those that do not show any external mutations.

Source: Cut from all Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
descriptions.zh:
异变感染体感染了火卫二上的所有鱼类，连那些看起来没有任何变异的鱼也感染了。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从魔胎之境鱼类中切割获取。

descriptions.en:
The Infestation provokes the growth of multiple, seemingly redundant brain-like clusters, whose function may be linked to hivemind activity. 

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Cryptosuctus fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Cryptosuctus on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Rolizor Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
感染导致了多个看似多余，且类似大脑的簇状物的生长，其功能可能与巢群活动有关。 

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从水肺和墓沼隐龙中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺、在'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面上捕捉墓沼隐龙。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和偌利佐尔感染包囊掉落。

descriptions.en:
Elements of other lifeforms are detectable in Infested body parts, such as this apparently parasitic clump of land-dwelling animal tissue.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Barbisteo fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch both Vitreospina and Barbisteo in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass. Also drops from Spitia Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
在 Infested 的身体部位中可以检测到其他生命形态的组成元素，例如这种明显属于陆地动物的寄生组织。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌中切割获取。 可在'秩序'和'混乱'期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌。此外它还会从魔胎之境的斯蒂亚感染包囊掉落。

descriptions.en:
Environmental contamination is co-responsible for mutations, alongside Infested cellular alteration.

Source: Cut from Ostimyr and Kymaeros fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Ostimyr in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Fass, and Kymaeros on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
环境污染与 Infested 细胞变化，这两个都是引起突变的原因。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从奥斯蒂剑鱼和高额异鳍中切割获取。 可在'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉奥斯蒂剑鱼、在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面捕捉高额异鳍。此外它还会从魔胎之境的感染包囊掉落。

descriptions.en:
Remnants of creatures' original bodily fluids persist post-Infestation, often crystalized or congealed into entirely new compounds.

Source: Cut from Amniophysi fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Amniophysi in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass.
descriptions.zh:
生物原有的体液残余物在感染后仍会存在，通常会结晶或凝结成全新的化合物。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从针刺长鳄中切割获取。 可在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴捕捉针刺长鳄。

descriptions.en:
These pressurized repositories of Infested spores require careful extraction or explosive rupture and local contamination may occur.

Source: Cut from Glutinox fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Glutinox on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
这些存有感染孢子的加压储存囊需要被小心提取，否则就会炸裂并且可能造成局部污染。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从狍鸮胶蛳中切割获取。可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉狍鸮胶蛳。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和感染包囊掉落。

descriptions.en:
The organs that once served as eyes, prior to Infestation, are still replete with useful components.

Source: Cut from Flagellocanth fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots using Processed Fass Residue during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
这件在感染前曾经作为眼睛的器官仍包含有用的成分。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从须腔棘鱼中切割获取。 可在'秩序'和'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中使用处理过的'混乱'残留物捕捉须腔棘鱼。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。

descriptions.en:
Used to latch on to other life forms for feeding purposes, and to inject them with anticoagulants and sporelets.

Source: Cut from Lobotriscid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Lobotriscid on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
用于附在其他生命体上以供养分，并把抗凝剂和孢子注入其中。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从额叶鲤中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉额叶鲤。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。

descriptions.en:
Sifting the glutinous Exocrine is an essential part of the survival process, and a reminder of the creature's original function.

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Duroid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Duroid in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Auroron Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
筛分粘性的外分泌物是生存过程中必不可少的一部分，也是对生物原有功能的一种提醒。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从水肺和韧铠灵鲷中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺，在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉韧铠灵鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和幻金英择谛罐掉落。

descriptions.en:
Many delicate and complex nerve fibers are housed in the jointed vertebrae, which are one of the creature's most resilient parts. Found from Vitreospina fish known to eke out a primitive existence in cave systems.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Chondricord fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Vitreospina in Cambion Drift caves during Fass and Vome, and Chondricord in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties and Sagiant Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
许多精巧而复杂的神经纤维被安置在有关节的脊椎骨中，这地方是生物最坚韧的部分之一。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从璃化脊鳎和骨锥琼鲷中切割获取。 可在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎，在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉骨锥琼鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金和智者英择谛罐掉落。

descriptions.en:
Beneath the membranous protein layers can be found a secondary 'skull'; flexible, tough and highly conductive.

Source: Cut from Myxostomata fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots using Processed Vome Residue during Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks in the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
在膜状蛋白层的下面，可以发现一个具有弹性、坚韧、且有着高导电性的次要'颅骨'。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从独角米索鳎中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中使用处理过的'秩序'残留物捕捉独角米索鳎。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑掉落。

descriptions.en: These fish were purposefully contaminated with the Infestation as an Entrati 'experiment'. They feed off the organic deposits in cave systems.
descriptions.zh: 这些鱼作为英择谛的 '实验'，有目的性地接受感染者感染。它们以洞穴系统中的有机沉积物为食。

descriptions.en: Crammed with redundant, mutated internal organs, this pungent fish mingles Orokin and Infested ancestry. It is confined to the Exocrine and is only active by the light of the Wyrm Fass.
descriptions.zh: 体内挤满了多余的、变异的内脏，这种刺鼻的鱼类混有奥罗金和感染者的血统。其活动区域仅限于外分泌液，并且只有在蛟龙'混乱'的光照下才会在出现。

descriptions.en: Whatever higher functions this fish once had have been consumed, leaving it a mere automaton of metal and flesh. It ekes out a primitive existence in cave systems.
descriptions.zh: 无论这种鱼类曾经有什么更高等的功能，都已经被消耗掉了。只剩下自动化的金属和肉体。它在洞穴系统中勉强维持着原始的习性。

descriptions.en: Formerly Orokin scavengers, these fish succumbed to the Infestation long ago and now greedily feast on floating spores. They are found all over the surface of Deimos.
descriptions.zh: 这些鱼类以前是奥罗金时代的清道夫，很久以前就屈从感染者了；现在贪婪地吃着漂浮的孢子。它们在火卫二的地表随处可见。

descriptions.zh: 这些鱼类从感染地表下形成的半透明卵囊中孵化出来。它们悬游进食。

descriptions.en: A muscular, three-tailed fish, the Lobotriscid trawls through Exocrine vapor across the surface of Deimos when Vome is dominant.
descriptions.zh: 这是一种肌肉发达的三尾鱼，当'秩序'在天空中占主导地位时，三尾额叶鲤会通过外分泌雾化膜在火卫二的地面拖网捕食。

descriptions.en: These specimens were originally parasites, breeding inside the wyrm-guts of Fass and scattered across Deimos in the debris of his explosive demise. They are drawn to his light.
descriptions.zh: 这些标本原本是寄生虫，在'混乱'的龙胆内繁殖，并随着其死亡喷射出的爆炸性残骸四散在了火卫二上。它们像飞蛾扑火般被'混乱'的光芒吸引着。

descriptions.en: These hefty fish are cannibalistic. They rise by Vome's light to absorb rare gases, retreating when Fass ascends to devour their smaller kin in their lairs.
descriptions.zh: 这些沉重的鱼类有自相残杀的习性。它们在'秩序'的光照下出现，吸收稀有气体，当'混乱'升起时撤回，吞噬它们巢穴中相对幼小的同族。

descriptions.en: While the Vallis coolant has kept this finely engineered Corpus tactical boot remarkably well preserved, it is, nonetheless, entirely worthless.
descriptions.zh: 虽然山谷冷却液将这精心设计的 Corpus 战靴保持得完好无缺，但它，仍没有一丝价值。

descriptions.en: This exceptionally rare breed of fish is almost extinct, as its gilded Orokin flesh has a special savor for predators. It warily conceals itself in caves.
descriptions.zh: 这种异常罕见的鱼种几乎要绝迹了，它那镀金的奥罗金鱼肉对掠食者来说有别具一格的味道。它小心翼翼地躲在洞穴里。

descriptions.zh: 一种可以追溯到奥罗金时代的活化石，这种神出鬼没的鱼类隐藏在洞穴最深处的外分泌液表面之下。不像其它感染者鱼类，它无法进行悬游。

descriptions.en: A triumph of Orokin bio-engineering, these hardy fish have adapted to the Deimos environment and seem oddly resistant to Infestation. They thrive in cave environments.
descriptions.zh: 一项奥罗金生物工程技术的胜利，这些坚毅的鱼类已经适应了火卫二的环境，并且似乎对感染者有着奇怪的抵抗力。它们在洞穴环境中茁壮成长。

descriptions.en: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
descriptions.zh: 有些理论认为，双衍王境坐落在一只巨大的载世龟壳上。自然而然地，一些人会想知道巨大的载世龟是站在什么之上的。答案当然是其他载世龟，一个接一个叠到底部。

descriptions.en: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
descriptions.zh: 黄金喉兽发现息壤鲳特别美味。

descriptions.en: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
descriptions.zh: 浮伤鱼喜欢在靠近水面的地方游。双衍王境的公民经常把它们误认为木头，当浮伤鱼露出它们的尖牙时，可能会让人大吃一惊。

descriptions.en: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
descriptions.zh: 纳土鲉已经进化出收紧尾部肌肉的能力，并把它的尾巴当成一种可怕的武器。

descriptions.en: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
descriptions.zh: 精灵鱼的颈部和头鳍可以伸展，让大多数的捕食者无法吞咽，但是黄金喉兽可以攻克它的防御。

descriptions.en: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.
descriptions.zh: 从它侧腹的发光腺体中释放出电流将它的猎物击晕。

descriptions.zh: 一种被血的气味吸引的捕食鱼类。

descriptions.zh: 尽管很少从深水中冒险游出，鲨客是可怕的捕食者，会捕食单独游泳的粗心 Ostron 人。

descriptions.en:
Harvested by the Ostron as a catalyst used in their synthetics.

Source: Cut from Charc Eels via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Charc Eels in the Plains of Eidolon lake at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
被 Ostron 收割来作为合成反应的催化剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从查克鳗中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野湖泊中捕捉查克鳗。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
Used in Ostron remedies to purify toxins.

Source: Cut from Goopolla fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Goopolla in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
在 Ostron 中的偏方被用来净化毒素。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从古泊拉鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中捕捉古泊拉。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
An ingredient used in Ostron cooking and medicine.

Source: Cut from Murkray fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Murkray in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots at any time of day using Murkray Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
Ostron 用来烹饪和制药的材料。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从阴暗鳐鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋鱼点中使用阴暗鳐鱼饵捕捉阴暗鳐。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
These will often adorn ceremonial garb or as a reagent for synthetics.

Source: Cut from Sharrac fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Sharrac in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
这些常常用来装点仪式装束，或者被用来做合成的反应物。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从鲨客鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中使用黄昏鱼饵捕捉鲨客。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
Ground into a powder this substance can makes fires burn hotter for a brief amount of time.

Source: Cut from Karkina fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Karkina in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
将这种物质磨成粉末可以短暂使得火烧得更旺。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从卡其那鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中使用黄昏鱼饵捕捉卡其那。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
The bones of the Mawfish are carved by the Ostron to produce ornaments and tools.

Source: Cut from Mawfish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Mawfish in the Plains of Eidolon lake during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
喉鱼的骨骼被 Ostron 人用来制作吊饰和工具。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从喉鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野湖泊中捕捉喉鱼。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
The poison is used to cure leather and as a reagent to produce an embalming fluid.

Source: Cut from Khut-Khut fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Khut-Khut in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
毒素被 Ostron 人用来加工皮革，以及作为制造一种防腐液的反应剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从库特-库特鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉库特-库特。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
Once cleaned and tanned this organ can be turned into a durable leather.

Source: Cut from Yogwun fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Yogwun in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
一旦经过清洗和鞣制后，这种器官可以变成耐用的皮革。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从约格温鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉约格温。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
The Ostron boil these into a jelly which forms a strong adhesive when it dries.

Source: Cut from Tralok fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Tralok in the Plains of Eidolon ocean during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
Ostron 人将其煮成胶状，干燥后便成为一种强力的粘合剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从塔洛鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野海洋中捕捉塔洛。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
The horn of the Mortus Lungfish is ground down into a powder and used by the Ostrons in herbal remedies.

Source: Cut from Mortus Lungfish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Mortus Lungfish in Plains of Eidolon ponds at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:
Ostron 的人们将摩图斯肺鱼的角碾碎成粉末状后用于草药之中。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从摩图斯肺鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉摩图斯肺鱼。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
Used as a source of food and to create bait for predatory fish.

Source: Cut from all Plains of Eidolon Fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
descriptions.zh:
被用作食物来源，并制作捕食者鱼类的诱饵。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从各种夜灵平野鱼类中切割获取。

descriptions.en:
Used to create absolvents that purify gems.

Source: Cut from all Plains of Eidolon Fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
descriptions.zh:
被用来制造净化宝石的溶剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从各种夜灵平野鱼类中切割获取。

descriptions.en:
A material used in tailoring clothes and cultivating synthetics.

Source: Cut from all Plains of Eidolon Fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

这种材料被用来裁制衣物和培育合成物。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从各种夜灵平野鱼类中切割获取。

descriptions.en:
This thick shell is used by Ostrons to manufacture tools and weapons.

Source: Cut from Glappid fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Glappid in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at Night using Glappid Bait. Also drops from Thumper Bulls in the Plains of Eidolon.
descriptions.zh:

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从盖拉佩德鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野海洋中使用盖拉佩德鱼饵捕捉盖拉佩德。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en:

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.en:

descriptions.zh:

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从克苏尔鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野池塘鱼点中捕捉克苏尔。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

descriptions.en: Synthetic fibers and a molded foam insole were the basis for what was once a robust and comfortable combat boot. Now, it's a home for tiny aquatic organisms.
descriptions.zh: 合成纤维与注塑泡沫制成了的鞋垫，曾经它是一只强韧、舒适的战斗靴。如今，它是小型水生生物体的家。

descriptions.en: You're catching a lot of these. Are you stocking up?
descriptions.zh: 你捕获了很多这玩意。你是在囤货吗？

descriptions.en: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
descriptions.zh: 盖拉佩德是一种以死鱼残骸为生的食腐动物。它与瑟拉姆甲虫形成了一种共生关系，甲虫将盖拉佩德摄入的毒素析出并以之为食。

descriptions.en: This fish inhabits the shallows and feeds of crabs and other small crustaceans. When threatened it forces air into its brain to give it the impression of being much bigger than it normally is.

A small, electronic brain capable of processing a billion giga-threads per second.

Source: Dismantled from Scrubber servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Scrubber in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
每秒能处理十亿吉字节线程的小型电子脑。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从洗涤者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉洗涤者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

descriptions.en:
A small, atomic power source.

Source: Dismantled from Brickie servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Brickie in Orb Vallis ponds and rivers during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
一个小型、原子能的能源。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从砖瓦匠伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘和河流中捕捉砖瓦匠。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

descriptions.en:
Controls the electrical flow throughout the circuitry within robotic organisms.

Source: Dismantled from Mirewinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Mirewinder in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
控制生化机器人体内电路系统的电流。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从污泥环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉污泥环绕者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

names.zh: 污泥绕环者并联生物二极体

descriptions.en:
A machine element used to propel robotic organisms through coolant.

Source: Dismantled from Eye-Eye servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Eye-Eye in Orb Vallis ponds during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
一种可以让生化机器人在冷却液中推进的机器组件。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从目－目伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉目－目。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

descriptions.en:
A weapon that discharges lasers over short distances.

Source: Dismantled from Kriller servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Kriller in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
一把能发射短距离激光的武器。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从磷虾杀手伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉磷虾杀手。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

descriptions.en:
A strong, metallic case that is resistant to fluctuations in environmental temperature.

Source: Dismantled from Sapcaddy servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Sapcaddy in the Orb Vallis lake during Cold weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
一个坚固、金属制的箱子，能抵抗环境温度的波动。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从液集者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉液集者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

descriptions.en:
A sample of sprockets, gyros and wires.

Source: Dismantled from all Orb Vallis servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
链轮、陀螺仪与电线的样品。 

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从伺服鱼中拆解获取。

descriptions.en:
A processing unit that efficiently monitors environmental data.

Source: Dismantled from Synathid servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Synathid in Orb Vallis cave hotspots during any weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
一个有效地监控环境数据的处理组件。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从海龙伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴鱼点中捕捉海龙。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
A solvent that reconstitutes waste product from the Weeping Towers into degenerated matter.

Source: Dismantled from Tromyzon servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Tromyzon in Orb Vallis Pond Hotspots during Cold weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
一种将渗流之塔的废弃物重建为简并物质的溶剂。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从多目鳗伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉多目鳗。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
A device used to reconstruct degenerated matter into Orokin bio-material.

Source: Dismantled from Charamote servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Charamote in Orb Vallis cave hotspots during any weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
一个用于将简并物质重建为奥罗金生物材料的装置。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从重筑虾伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴鱼点中捕捉重筑虾。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

descriptions.en:
Discharges excess heat and energy through the casing.

Source: Dismantled from Tink servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Tink in Orb Vallis ponds during Cold weather.
descriptions.zh:
经由外壳释放多余的热量和能量。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从修补机伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉修补机。

descriptions.en:
A liquid that mixes with coolant fluid to produce a resilient gel that repairs leaks.

Source: Dismantled from Longwinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Longwinder in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during Warm weather.
descriptions.zh:
混合了冷却液，产生出一种有弹性的凝胶，用于修复裂缝。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从长型环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊鱼点中捕捉长型环绕者。

names.zh: 长型环绕者车床凝聚剂

descriptions.en:
Interprets signals from other mechanical organisms.

Source: Dismantled from Recaster servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Recaster in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during Cold weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
descriptions.zh:
用于理解来自另一个机械有机体的讯号。

descriptions.en: Struck to commemorate the Entrati family's power and prestige, as well as safeguarding their memories of one another. Many things changed in the years that followed, and that which had once shone brightly grew dark and dim. But even a single Ayatan Star may make all the difference.
descriptions.zh: 这尊雕像之所以被打造出来，不仅是为了纪念英择谛家族的实力与威望，同时也是为了保存家族成员之间的珍贵记忆。时过境迁，曾今闪耀的雕像现已变得暗淡无光。但只要插上一颗阿耶檀识星，它就会变得截然不同。

Refined purity freed from the Infested mass.

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.

从感染生物处精炼得到的提纯物。

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

Infested neurotransmitters condensed under pressure.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions, Sagiant Entrati Caskets, and Bonus Vaults in Isolation Vault Bounties.
descriptions.zh:
感染神经递质在压力下凝结而成。

Crystalline symmetry, a far cry from its corrupt origin.

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

Rivulets of Exocrine fluid, hardened over passing centuries.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions, Sagiant Entrati Casket, and Bonus Vaults in Isolation Vault Bounties.

Purged of spores and contaminants, this alloy is highly versatile.

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

Sinewy and metallic, possessed of great elastic strength.

有韧性和金属感，具有很强的弹性。

Fused with its inert Infested tendrils into a durable alloy.

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

Malleable, owing to ingrown veins of Infestation protein.

descriptions.en: Helminth is able to digest all manner of miscellaneous substances, but generates a large surplus of bile in order to do so. Fortunately, this bile can be repurposed.
descriptions.zh: Helminth 可以消化各种杂物，但会因此而产生过量的消化液。幸运的是，这些消化液可以再次被利用。

descriptions.en: Plant-based materials of all kinds are processed and liquidized within the Helminth's digestive tract; the surplus is excreted as an inoffensive, inert clump.
descriptions.zh: 各种植物类物质会在 Helminth 的消化道内被处理、液化，剩余的残留物则会被以无害惰性块状物的形式排出体外。

descriptions.en: On consuming minerals, Helminth converts those it does not fully absorb into a smooth, rich paste with a faint vanilla odor.
descriptions.zh: 在享用矿物质时，Helminth 会把那些未被完全吸收的矿物质转化为光滑浓郁、并带有淡淡香草味的糊状物。

descriptions.en: Metallic substances, steadily corroded by the Helminth's digestive juices and exuded as a coarse powder.
descriptions.zh: 金属物质，被 Helminth 的消化液不断腐蚀，并以大颗粒粉尘的形式分泌了出来。

descriptions.en: When Helminth consumes Infested matter it creates greasy intestine-like casings, bloats them with a dark, musky gas and ejects them. The reason for this is unknown and probably best left that way.
descriptions.zh: 当 Helminth 享用了感染物质后，它会产生油腻的肠道状外壳，并通过黑色的麝香气体使其膨胀，然后将其喷射出来。这种现象的产生原因不明，可能最好不要去管它。

descriptions.en: Helminth eagerly consumes artificial materials and exudes these rope-like strands of filament as a useful byproduct.
descriptions.zh: Helminth 热衷于享用人造材料，并会分泌出这些绳状的细丝，可被作为一种有用的副产品。

descriptions.en: Loid uses devices in Albrecht's Laboratory to reduce Arcanes to Vosfor, a potent powder for alchemical processes. Speak to Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to trade Vosfor for Arcanes he has stored in the laboratory.
descriptions.zh: 洛德使用阿尔布雷希特实验室中的装置将赋能分解成荧尘，这是一种用于转换的强效粉末。在火卫二的解剖圣所与洛德对话，用荧尘交换他存放在实验室中的赋能。

descriptions.en: Nearby Duviri Enigmas will be marked with a waypoint.
descriptions.zh: 附近的双衍王境奥理将标注为标记点。

descriptions.en:
A gas found solely on the Plains of Eidolon, refined to its purest form. 

Location: Plains of Eidolon Bounties on Earth
descriptions.zh:
一种只能在夜灵平野上找到的气体，已被精炼到了最纯粹的状态。

获取地点：夜灵平野赏金任务（地球）

descriptions.en:
Awarded by the Arbiters of Hexis to the few Tenno capable of surviving Arbitration.

Location: Arbitration Missions
descriptions.zh:
由均衡仲裁者授予少数能从仲裁中幸存的 Tenno。

获取地点：仲裁任务

descriptions.en: Distilled fuel for stims.
descriptions.zh: 提炼而成的刺激剂原料。

descriptions.en:
Alloy pellets used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Mercury, Earth, Lua, Neptune, and the Void
descriptions.zh:
Grineer 在制造过程中使用的合金块。

获取地点：水星，地球，月球，海王星和虚空

descriptions.en:
A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses?

Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
descriptions.zh:
在萃取过程中能被冷却液稀释的液态岩浆。在热爆过程中，热美亚会出现在奥布山谷表面，并导致热美亚裂缝的产生。或许它就是瓦解剥削者圆蛛防御机制的关键？

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）上的热美亚裂缝活动

descriptions.en: A Greater Lens that channels Affinity into Focus for one of the five Tenno Ways.
descriptions.zh: 一颗将经验值转换为五项 Tenno 之道专精的高级晶体。

descriptions.en: An Eidolon Lens enhanced with resonance from Somatic Fibers.
descriptions.zh: 一颗通过活体纤维的共振来强化的夜灵晶体。

descriptions.en: An enhanced Greater Lens that has been infused with Breath of the Eidolon.
descriptions.zh: 一颗注入了夜灵之息的强化高级晶体。

descriptions.en:
Turns a conventional mod into a work of art. An Atragraph Mod.

Find Aspirant Zorba on a relay to create Atragraph Mods.
descriptions.zh:
将传统 Mod 变成艺术品。墨染 Mod。

在一个中继站找到见习仲裁者左巴即可制作墨染 Mod。

descriptions.en: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
descriptions.zh: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

descriptions.en:
Modifies any slot to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.

*Umbra Polarity not included.
descriptions.zh:
改变任何槽位以与任何 Mod 极性兼容。

*不包括 Umbra 极性。

descriptions.en: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
descriptions.zh: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

descriptions.en: Modifies a Stance slot on a melee weapon to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.
descriptions.zh: 改变近战武器上的架式槽位以与任何 Mod 的极性相容。

descriptions.en:
Forma that can apply the UMBRA polarity.

This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe or Melee Weapon to UMBRA polarity and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes and Melee Weapons.
descriptions.zh:
可以设置 UMBRA 极性的 Forma。

这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的基础构件。它可以改变战甲或武器的极性槽至 UMBRA 极性，并将其等级重置为无等级。这项物品只能用于满级的战甲及近战武器。

descriptions.en:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.

Location: Mars and Uranus
descriptions.zh:
用于微电子和能量武器的软金属。

获取地点：火星和天王星

descriptions.en: A corrupted decryption key dating back to the founding of the city of Corposium. Millions of these Holokeys were lost to the Void when Parvos Granum's flagship was bombed. Strongly desired by Ergo Glast.
descriptions.zh: 一把堕落解密钥匙，起源可以追溯到 Corposium 之城建立的时期。当帕尔沃斯·格拉努的旗舰被炸毁时，数以百万计这样的全息密钥就失落在了虚空中。Ergo Glast 对这件物品情有独钟。

descriptions.en: Used in the construction of Javloks
descriptions.zh: 用于燃焰标枪的制造

descriptions.en:
Allows archwing guns to be deployed in terrestrial zones. Install this device on archwing guns to compensate for atmospheric and gravitational forces not experienced in space.
NOTE: Deployment requires gear obtained from the Profit-Taker mission in Fortuna.
descriptions.zh:
允许曲翼枪械在陆地区域使用。陆地环境中存在着太空环境所没有的大气压力与重力，在曲翼枪械上安装这个装置就能抵消上述差异所带来的绝大部分影响。
注意：在部署时需要用到福尔图娜的利润收割者任务中取得的道具。

descriptions.en: Coordinate used to locate Councilor Vay Hek.
descriptions.zh: 用来定位韦·海克的坐标

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth a spectral axe during aerial and slide attacks in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有在空中和滑行攻击时发出一把光谱战斧的能力。

names.zh: 认知 & 冲击灵化之源

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to temporarily increase Range and inflict guaranteed <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status for all attacks after a successful slide attack in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这把武器的技能，在灵化形态下成功进行滑行攻击后，暂时增加攻击范围同时其所有攻击都可造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase Range and Heavy Attack Efficiency in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有增加范围和重击效率的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth spectral daggers during Heavy Attacks in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有发射光谱匕首的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to summon ghostly rapiers that fly forth upon Heavy Attacks, while Heavy Attack kills grant <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击发射幽影细剑，同时重击击杀获得 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to create a <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage field after a kill in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有击杀产生 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害力场的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Heavy Slam Efficiency and leave behind <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage fields after Heavy Slams in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有提高重型震地效率，重型震地攻击后留下 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害力场的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to embed blades that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage during Forward and Neutral Combos in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下进行向前和中立连击时具有嵌入带有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的爆炸刀片的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase Initial Combo and Wind Up Speed in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有提升初始连击和重击准备速度的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to greatly increase its range in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有大幅提升范围的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to perform a large radial attack for each Finisher hit in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次处决攻击都能发动范围攻击的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to spawn spectral daggers on kill. Daggers seek out enemies, applying max <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status stacks.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下击杀敌人会生成光谱匕首的能力。匕首会自动寻找敌人，造成最大的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态叠层。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to create a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Blast Radius with Heavy Slams, slowing enemies and increasing Critical Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有在重型震地攻击时制造一片 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻爆炸范围，还有减缓敌人速度和增加暴击伤害的能力。

names.zh: 西伯利亚冰锤灵化之源

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to stun nearby enemies when it enters Incarnon Form and after Finisher attacks.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在进行灵化形态时和进行处决攻击后具有晕眩附近敌人的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire three short-range beams that chain link enemies in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射三道短程光束链接敌人的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to prioritize <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and gain Multishot in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有优先造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害并获得多重射击的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with each shot in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次射击具有范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain an Auto Fire mode and deal Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with each shot in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次射击具有自动射击模式和造成范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire high power beams and gain <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Damage.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射高能光束并造成 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力伤害的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to sacrifice silence for increased projectile size and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有牺牲静音以增加投射物大小和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire embedding projectiles that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸的嵌入式投射物的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage energy waves that bounce off enemies and terrain in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射遇到敌人和地形反弹的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害能量波的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire homing and bouncing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage explosives in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射追踪和反弹式 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸物的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to sacrifice silence for increased projectile size and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有牺牲静音以增加投射物大小和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain increased Status Chance and Multishot while slowing fire rate in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有降低射速、增加触发几率和多重射击的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire staggering explosive projectiles in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射令敌人失衡的爆炸投射物的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire 4-round bursts and gain <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Status.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下可发射 4 连发并造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸异常状态的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire a long-range <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin beam in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射远距离 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素光束的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire slowing projectiles that explode upon headshots in Incarnon Form. Transforms on Alt Fire while unscoped.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射减速投射物的能力，并在爆头击杀时爆炸。未瞄准时，通过次要射击可变形。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to launch target-seeking fireballs that ricochet toward enemies in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射自动瞄准并弹向敌人的火球的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire high-powered grenades in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射高能榴弹的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire cross-shaped projectiles high in <DT_SLASH_COLOR> Slash Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有高 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害的十字形投射物的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase its Range and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有增加范围和跳弹的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase its Critical Chance the longer it is fired uninterrupted.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有连续射击时间越长暴击几率越大的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain embedding projectiles that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下获得造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸的嵌入式投射物的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain an Auto Fire mode and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有自动射击模式和跳弹的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to project a wide <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage beam in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射一束广范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害光束的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire projectiles that pull enemies into a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage explosion in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射投射物将敌人拉入 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害爆炸中的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to seek Headshots and increase Multishot in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有追踪爆头和增加多重射击的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Punch Through and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有穿透和跳弹的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire energy waves that deal <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation and Punch Through damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射和穿透伤害的能量波的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to ricochet its bullets.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下的子弹跳弹能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to unleash a chaotic maelstrom of bouncing corrosive blobs in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下释放出混乱的、弹跳的腐蚀性泡状物的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to rapidly empty its entire magazine in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有高速全弹发射的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to charge a large single shot that deals Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有蓄力进行一次造成范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的大型单发射击的能力。

descriptions.en:
These coordinates can be used to track Mutalist Alad V.

Location: Infestation Outbreaks Invasion Rewards, Hyf and Terrorem (Deimos), and Resource Caches found in Naeglar (Eris) and Formido (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
这些坐标可用于追踪异融阿拉德 V。

获取地点：感染者爆发入侵奖励、Hyf 和 Terrorem（火卫二）、Naeglar（阋神星）和 Formido（火卫二）中的资源储藏箱

names.zh: 异融阿拉德 V 导航坐标

descriptions.en: This single-use item instantly repairs a damaged component or armament in the Dry Dock.
descriptions.zh: 一次性物品，可以立即在干船坞内修复一件损坏的部件或军备。

descriptions.en:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

descriptions.en:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

descriptions.en:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

descriptions.en:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

descriptions.en: Chipper's current Stock level. Raise his Stock level by completing Kahl's Break Narmer missions.
descriptions.zh: 切片哥当前的存货储备量。通过完成卡尔的「击溃合一众」任务来增加他的存货储备量。

descriptions.en:
Points earned through victories in Rathuum.

Obtained from Rathuum Arena missions on Nakki, Yam, and Vodyanoi (Sedna).
descriptions.zh:
通过在死亡角斗场中获得胜利来赚取的点数。

通过在 Nakki、Yam、Vodyanoi（赛德娜）的死亡角斗场竞技场任务获得。

descriptions.en:
Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints.

Location: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)
descriptions.zh:
赤毒是 Grineer 女皇梦寐以求的一种非常罕见的红色液体。它可以从赤毒任务中获得，用来循环裂罅 Mod 或者制造稀有蓝图。

获取地点：赤毒虹吸任务、Taveuni（赤毒要塞）

descriptions.en: A small fragment of Belric's Crystal from Tyana Pass on Mars.
descriptions.zh: 来自火星 Tyana Pass 的一小块贝里克的水晶碎片。

descriptions.en: A small fragment of Rania's Crystal from Tyana Pass on Mars.
descriptions.zh: 来自火星 Tyana Pass 的一小块拉尼娅的水晶碎片。

descriptions.en: Chance for each scan with the Synthesis Scanner to count as two scans.
descriptions.zh: 每次以结合扫描器执行扫描时，有几率进行二次扫描。

descriptions.en: Synthesis Scanner will now show target enemy weaknesses and resistances.
descriptions.zh: 结合扫描器将显示目标敌人的弱点和抗性。

descriptions.en: Recharges Synthesis Scanner charges.
descriptions.zh: 为结合扫描器充电。

descriptions.en: Reduces the time required to scan a target with the Synthesis Scanner.
descriptions.zh: 降低结合扫描器扫描目标所需的时间。

descriptions.en: Harvested from the debris left by fallen Orphix Sentients, Phasic Cells seem to be key to pulse function. These components can be traded with Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: 从战败的 Sentient 奥影母艇残骸中收集而来，相位电池似乎是脉冲功能的关键。在殁世幽都中，可以与'父亲'交易这些组件。

descriptions.en:
Neural fibers sampled from an early Warframe prototype and preserved in a stabilized cerebral fluid.

Location: Demolishers on Apollo (Lua), and Conjunction Survival Missions (Lua)
descriptions.zh:
从早期战甲原型采样并保存在一种稳定的脑液中的神经纤维。

获取地点：Apollo（月球）上的爆破型敌人、联结生存任务（月球）。

descriptions.en:
This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions.

Location: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key
descriptions.zh:
这一装置可用来破解奥罗金的加密。

获取地点：通过龙钥开启过的奥罗金遗迹宝库（火卫二）

descriptions.en: Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
descriptions.zh: 为这个物品解锁 1 个额外的外观配置槽位，最多 3 个额外槽位。

names.en: additional mod config slot for this item
names.zh: 为这件物品解锁额外的 MOD 配置槽位

descriptions.en:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto
descriptions.zh:
非晶态的固体。可能是奥罗金技术。

获取地点：水星，火星，火卫一，欧罗巴和冥王星

descriptions.en:
This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.
descriptions.zh:
这种高反应性的矿藏是已知唯一能让王子菇成长的物质。

获取地点：金星福尔图娜下方的深矿。

descriptions.en:
Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.

Location: Saturn, Neptune, Eris, and Deimos
descriptions.zh:
纤维状的科技细胞肿瘤。请谨慎处理感染者组织。

获取地点：土星，海王星，阋神星和火卫二

descriptions.en:
An adaptive Sentient base component responsible for communication flows. Used extensively in the Narmer invasion. A valuable commodity for both The Quills and Vox Solaris.

Location: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)
descriptions.zh:
一种用于 Sentient 通讯流的适应性基本组件。在合一众入侵时被广泛使用。对夜羽和索拉里斯之声来说都是一种很有价值的商品。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）和奥布山谷（金星）中的合一众赏金任务

descriptions.en:
Coordinate used to locate lost ships.

Location: Dropped from Storage Containers
descriptions.zh:
用来找到失踪飞船的坐标。

获取地点：可在储存容器中获得

descriptions.en:
Implanted neural-link for controlling augmentations. Grineer design.

Location: Jupiter
descriptions.zh:
植入式的神经连接，用于控制各类扩增强化系统，由 Grineer 设计。

获取地点：木星。

descriptions.en:
Biotech sensor organ harvested from Infested entities.

Location: Earth, Lua, Eris, and Deimos
descriptions.zh:
从感染者身上收集的生物感应器官。

获取地点：地球，月球，阋神星和火卫二

descriptions.en:
Produced by a Fomorian's power core, these particles only appear on or around planets where a Fomorian is present.

Location: When a Balor Fomorian is threatening a Planet's Relay, enemies on that Planet will drop this resource
descriptions.zh:
由巨人战舰动力核心所产生，这些粒子仅出现在巨人战舰活动当地或邻近的星球上。 

获取地点：当巴罗尔巨人战舰威胁到星球中继站时，该星球的敌人便会掉落这种资源

descriptions.en: Orokin modification technology used to super-charge weaponry. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Weapon.
descriptions.zh: 用来大幅度强化武器的奥罗金改造科技。能使武器获得两倍的 Mod 点数容量。

descriptions.en:
Ancient energy cell from the Orokin era.

Location: Ceres, Saturn, and Deimos
descriptions.zh:
奥罗金时代流传下来的的远古能量电池。

获取地点：谷神星，土星和火卫二

descriptions.en: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.
descriptions.zh: 反应堆用于大幅提升战甲的能力。且能将战甲、曲翼及同伴的 Mod 容量提升为两倍。

descriptions.en:
Oxium is a rare lighter than air alloy of Orokin origin, used in certain Corpus Robotics.

Location: Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Neptune, Pluto, Eris, Europa, and Lua.
descriptions.zh:
奥席金属产于奥罗金，是一种比空气还轻的稀有合金，被用于部分 Corpus 机器人。

获取地点：金星，木星，火星，海王星，冥王星，阋神星，欧罗巴和月球。

descriptions.en:
A disgusting nanite-infested tissue mass.

Location: Phobos, Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, and Eris
descriptions.zh:
布满纳米机器人的恶心组织肿块。

获取地点：火卫一，土星，天王星，冥王星和阋神星

descriptions.en:
A hard, thermoplastic casing. Manufactured by Corpus.

Location: Mercury, Venus, and Uranus
descriptions.zh:
一种坚硬、 热塑性的塑料套管。由 Corpus 制造。

获取地点：水星，金星和天王星
