descriptions.en: Currency exchanged for Prime components and used to purchase items from the Void Trader.
descriptions.zh: 由Prime部件兑换的货币，可用于在虚空商人处购买商品。

descriptions.en:
Excess circuitry disposed of during the Razorback manufacturing process, these components only appear in the vicinity of high level outer-orbit Corpus facilities after a Razorback Armada has been launched.

Location: Corpus Archwing units on Jupiter and Neptune when a Razorback Armada is active
descriptions.zh:
制造利刃豺狼过程中的多余回路。在利刃豺狼舰队上阵后，这些组件只会出现在高等的 Corpus 外环设施之中。

获取地点：利刃豺狼舰队活动期间木星和海王星上的 Corpus 曲翼单位

descriptions.en:
A fragment of a sundered Riven. It is known that, with enough slivers, Palladino is capable of reforging a complete Riven. Find her in the Iron Wake (Earth) after completing The Chains of Harrow quest.

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics
descriptions.zh:
破裂的裂罅 Mod 碎块。有了足够的碎块，Palladino 就可以重铸一张完整的裂罅 Mod。完成《Harrow 的枷锁》系列任务后可在钢铁守望（地球）中找到她。

获取地点：卓越者单位、安魂遗物

descriptions.en: Use this cipher to instantly complete one Veiled Riven Challenge at the cost of consuming the cipher.
descriptions.zh: 使用并消耗破解器即可立即完成一项尚未揭开的裂罅 Mod 挑战。

descriptions.en:
Used in the Mod Workbench to splice Riven traits into a new trait from a special pool of possibilities.

Obtained by completing The Icebind on Yuvan Peak.
descriptions.zh: 可以在 Mod 工作台使用，将裂罅属性从特殊可能性池中拼接成新的属性。

descriptions.en:
A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy.

Location: Earth, Lua, Phobos, Europa, Pluto, Sedna, and the Void
descriptions.zh:
锯齿状的结晶矿。放出辐射能量。

获取地点：地球，月球，火卫一，欧罗巴，冥王星，赛德娜和虚空

descriptions.zh:

获取地点：火星，木星和赛德娜

Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

Location: Void Missions and Bounties
descriptions.zh:
未加工的奥罗金记忆等离子。瓦奇娅的铸造厂可以消耗阿耶精华来制造虚空遗物。可在火星上 Maroo 的市集里找到她。

获取地点：虚空和赏金任务

descriptions.en:
A shard ripped from a Sentient Anomaly in the Veil Proxima. Little Duck is known to trade these for other exotic goods somewhere in Fortuna on Venus.

Location: Murex ships found in Veil Proxima nodes marked with a special flashing icon (Railjack)
descriptions.zh:
从面纱比邻星域中的 Sentient 异常事件中扯下的碎片。小鸭子会在福尔图娜的某个地方用异域货物交易这些碎片，她以这种交易被人所熟知。

获取地点：面纱比邻星域节点中标有特殊的闪烁图标（航道星舰）的骨螺战舰

descriptions.en:
Retrieved from the shores of a sacred fate dream.

Location: Saya's Visions on Earth
descriptions.zh:
取自神圣命运梦境的彼岸。

获取地点：萨娅的异象（地球）

descriptions.en: Increases plasma beam range.
descriptions.zh: 提升等离子光束的距离。

names.zh: 阳点等离子钻头范围改造器

descriptions.en: Mine in peace and avoid alerting nearby enemies with this drill silencing widget.
descriptions.zh: 用这个钻头消音改造器来和平地挖矿并避免让敌人警戒。

names.zh: 阳点等离子钻头消音改造器

descriptions.en:
Discharged specter particles form an inert dust that can be collected and re-energized for various robotic projects.

Location: Errant Specters in the Granum Void (Corpus Ship Tileset)
descriptions.zh:
释放的魅影粒子形成一种惰性粉尘，可以收集起来为各种机器人项目重新充能。

获取地点：格拉努虚空（Corpus 飞船场景）中的游荡魅影

descriptions.en: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
descriptions.zh: 对巨人战舰反应堆注射这个污染物会造成燃料失调，失调的精密反应堆最后会发生聚爆，并摧毁船只，缓慢但是有效，推荐给独行 Tenno。

descriptions.en: Tokens of Teshin's Esteem earned from Incursion Alerts or Acolytes on The Steel Path. Can be exchanged for items that prove your warrior capabilities by visiting Teshin in any Relay.
descriptions.zh: 从钢铁之路侵袭警报任务或是追随者那里获取的代表 Teshin 尊严的代币。可被用来在任意中继站的 Teshin 处换取证明你战士能力的物品。

descriptions.en: Tokens of Teshin's Esteem earned from Incursion Alerts or Acolytes on The Steel Path. Can be exchanged for items that prove your warrior capabilities by visiting Teshin in any Relay.
descriptions.zh: 从钢铁之路侵袭警报任务或是追随者那里获取的代表 Teshin 尊严的代币。可被用来在任意中继站的 Teshin 处换取证明你战士能力的物品。

descriptions.en:
A component of the Antiserum Injector.

Location: Oestrus on Eris
descriptions.zh:
一只抗血清注射器的部件。

获取地点：阋神星的 Oestrus

names.zh: 执刑官欺谋狼主的源力石
执刑官诡文枭主的源力石
执刑官混沌蛇主的源力石

descriptions.en:
This rare metal is foreign to the Origin System and can only be found in asteroids that have made the long journey from other stars.

Location: Archwing Missions on Uranus
descriptions.zh:
这种罕见的金属来自始源星系之外，只能从来自其他恒星的小行星上获得。

获取地点：天王星上的曲翼任务

descriptions.en: Injecting this fluid into a Warframe will imbue it with the ability to fight autonomously alongside the Operator. Injection requires the use of the Helminth Infirmary, and the ability wears off after 24 hours.
descriptions.zh: 将这种液体注入战甲内，使其具有与指挥官并肩作战的能力。注射需要使用 Helminth 医务间，并且该能力会在 24 小时后消失。

descriptions.en: Fuses with a Warframe to unlock the Exilus Mod Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一架战甲来解锁特殊功能槽。

names.zh: 战甲特殊功能槽连接器

descriptions.en: Use the Elemental Vice to change the Elemental Damage Type of an Adversary Weapon.
descriptions.zh: 使用元素恶癖来改变对手武器的元素伤害类型。

descriptions.en: Locator beacon broadcasting on the delta frequency
descriptions.zh: 持续发送出 Delta 频率的信标定位装置。

descriptions.en: Locator beacon broadcasting on the gamma frequency
descriptions.zh: 持续发送出 Gamma 频率的信标定位装置

descriptions.en: Locator beacon broadcasting on the kappa frequency
descriptions.zh: 持续发送出 Kappa 频率的信标定位装置

descriptions.en: Locator beacon broadcasting on the Omega frequency
descriptions.zh: 持续发送出 Omega 频率的信标定位装置

descriptions.en:
A substance used to increase the power within Relics.

Location: Void Fissure Missions
descriptions.zh:
一种用来增加遗物内在能力的物质。

获取地点：虚空裂缝任务

descriptions.en: Nakak in Cetus would probably like these. Maybe she'll trade something special for them.
descriptions.zh: 希图斯的娜卡可能会喜欢这个。她可能会拿些特别的东西来和你交易。

descriptions.en: Fuses with an Amp to unlock an Arcane Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一件增幅器来解锁一个赋能槽位。

descriptions.en: Fuses with an Archgun weapon to unlock one of its two available Arcane Slots.
descriptions.zh: 与曲翼枪械武器融合以解锁其两个可用的赋能槽位之一。

names.zh: 曲翼枪械赋能槽连接器

descriptions.en: Fuses with a Melee weapon to unlock the Arcane Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一件近战武器来解锁赋能槽位。

names.zh: 近战武器赋能槽连接器

descriptions.en: Fuses with a Primary weapon to unlock the Arcane Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一件主要武器来解锁赋能槽位。

names.zh: 主要武器赋能槽连接器

descriptions.en: Fuses with a Secondary weapon to unlock the Arcane Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一件次要武器来解锁赋能槽位。

names.zh: 次要武器赋能槽连接器

descriptions.en: Fuses with a compatible weapon to unlock its Exilus Mod Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一把适用的武器来解锁其特殊功能槽。

names.zh: 武器特殊功能槽连接器

descriptions.en:
A volatile mushroom with an acrid odor similar to freshly detonated explosives. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种挥发性蘑菇，散发着类似刚引爆的炸药的刺鼻气味。把它带到气密舱夜帽那里以获取更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This bizarre mushroom appears to be permanently frozen. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种古怪的蘑菇似乎被永久冻住了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处来了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom appears to continually excrete a highly acidic mucus. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇似乎会不断分泌强酸性的黏液。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This fungus appears to emit an electric charge. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种真菌似乎会释放电荷。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This gaseous mushroom exhibits a terrible stench. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种气态蘑菇散发出难闻的恶臭。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom is always hot to the touch. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇摸起来总是炽热的。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom is hard as an anvil and nearly as heavy. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇坚硬如铁砧，重量也几乎相当。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
An oddly shaped fungus that will latch itself onto metallic objects. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种形状古怪的真菌，会附着在金属物体上。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽那里了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom is as plain as plain can be. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇普通得不能再普通了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
Avoid stepping on this sharp, spear-like mushroom cap. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
小心别踩到这种尖锐如长矛般的蘑菇伞盖。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
A potentially radioactive mushroom. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种可能具有放射性的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
The spines on this mushroom appear to be extremely sharp. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇上的尖刺看起来极为锋利。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
A peculiar looking mushroom that seems not of this world. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种外观奇特，仿佛不属于这个世界的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
A snake-like mushroom that should be handled with caution.  Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种蛇形的蘑菇，处理时应格外小心。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This multi-capped mushroom should probably not be ingested. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种多伞盖的蘑菇最好不要食用。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
A mushroom of unknown origin or effect. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种来历和效应都不明的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This common plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种常见的植物只能在白天找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光去壳毬果植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This common plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种常见的植物只能在黑夜找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光去壳毬果植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This plant was introduced to arid regions across the Origin System, for its ability to collect moisture in harsh environments. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Ruk's Claw plants that grow on Mars
descriptions.zh:
这种植物被引进遍布于始源星系的干旱地带，储存水分的能力使其得以对抗严酷的环境。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在火星的 Ruk 之爪植物获得

descriptions.en: Extracted from Skateweed.
descriptions.zh: 从鳐鱼草中萃取出的精华物。

descriptions.en:
One of the few known plant species able to thrive on asteroids in deep space. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Vestan Moss plants that grow on Mercury, Saturn, and Sedna
descriptions.zh:
为数不多的能够在外太空小行星上繁衍生息的已知植物物种之一。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在水星、土星和赛德娜上的灶神藓植物获得

descriptions.en: Extracted from a Cerulean Fungus colony.
descriptions.zh: 从蔚蓝菌群中萃取出的精华物。

descriptions.en: Extracted from a Ghost Brush.
descriptions.zh: 从鬼影之拂中萃取出的精华物。

descriptions.en:
This rare plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种稀有的植物只能在白天找到。 

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光玉叶植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This rare plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种稀有的植物只能在黑夜找到。 

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光玉叶植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This uncommon plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种罕见的植物只能在白天找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光龙百合植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This uncommon plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种罕见的植物只能在黑夜找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光龙百合植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This resilient plant provides a natural food source in frigid areas of the Origin system. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Frostleaf plants that grow on Venus, Neptune, and Pluto
descriptions.zh:
这种坚韧不拔的植物为始源星系的寒冷地区提供了天然的食物来源。 

获取地点：通过扫采集生长在金星、海王星和冥王星上的霜叶植物获得

descriptions.en:
This robust, carnivorous plant has adapted to conditions in polluted waters. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Dusklight Sarracenia plants growing in Grineer Shipyards found commonly on Ceres
descriptions.zh:
这种强壮的食虫植物已经适应了在污染水域下生存。 

获取地点：通过采集常见于谷神星，生长在 Grineer 造船厂的尘光瓶子草植物获取

descriptions.en:
This carnivorous plant can be found growing in the wilderness on Lua. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Lunar Pitcher plants that grow on Lua
descriptions.zh:
这种食虫植物可以在月球的荒野之中找到。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在月球的月之猪笼草植物获得

descriptions.en:
Formed over billions of years, these crystals are most often found embedded in space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
这些晶体形成了数十亿年，最常被发现嵌入太空岩石中。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
Once installed, these delicate power systems fuse with a Corpus Obelisk's engines. Unused capacitors are therefore, highly prized.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
安装后，这些精致的电源系统将与 Corpus 方尖碑引起融为一体。因此，未被使用的电容器非常珍贵。 

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: A rare bacterial entity that increases the spread of Infestation found on Infested Ships.
descriptions.zh: 一种罕见的细菌实体，可以促进感染战舰上发现的感染的扩散传播

descriptions.en:
Resilient components used to reinforce the plated sheets of metal strapped to Grineer Ships.

Location: Eximus units in the Grineer Shipyard Tileset, and Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
用于加固绑在 Grineer 战舰上的镀金板的弹性部件。

获取地点：Grineer 船坞场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A cell of encapsulated Void energy.

Location: Lua
descriptions.zh:
一个封装着虚空能量的单元。

获取地点：月球

descriptions.en:
Vital components used in the creation of Corpus photon-networks.

Location: Eximus units in the Corpus Ice Planet Tileset, and Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
用于创建 Corpus 光子网络的重要部件。

获取地点：Corpus 冰原星球场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: A rare Orokin material used to create a tear in space and allow safe passage through the Void.
descriptions.zh: 一种稀有的奥罗金材料，用于撕裂空间以安全通过虚空。

descriptions.en:
Antimatter fuel cell that powers the Grineer Ships.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
为 Grineer 战舰提供动力的反物质燃料电池。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A self-replicating fluid comprised of nanoproxies capable of independently repairing worn and damaged systems.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
一种由纳米机器人组成并且能自我复制的液体，能够独立修复磨损和损坏的系统。

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: Orokin devices used for navigating the solar winds.
descriptions.zh: 用于应对太阳风的奥罗金设备。

descriptions.en:
A component used in secure Grineer communication networks.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
一块用于确保 Grineer 通信网络安全的组件。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
Nullstones do not conform to several laws of physics, making them highly prized for optimizing sensitive components.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
虚无碎片并不符合几条重要的物理定律，因其可用于高灵敏度部件的优化而非常珍贵。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A parasitic growth that often infects Eximus units operating in Infested environs.

Location: Eris
descriptions.zh:
在感染者环境中的卓越者单位经常受到的一种寄生物感染。

获取地点：阋神星

descriptions.en:
High-density alloy armor plating used in the construction of offensive spacecraft.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
用于建造攻击性战舰的高致密合金装甲板。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
This highly malleable metal was exploited in great quantities by the Orokin and can now only be found within space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
这种柔软的金属曾被奥罗金过度开采，现在只能在太空陨石里找到。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.
descriptions.zh: 一种在感染者飞船上发现的器官，被认为能促进感染者蜂巢群体思维的交流。

descriptions.en: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
descriptions.zh: Tenno 中继站构造中的一个组成部分。

descriptions.en: With a blazing orange hue and rigid material strength, this compound is prized by ship and station architects.
descriptions.zh: 这种化合物具有炽热的橙色色调和坚硬的材料强度，受到船舰及中继站建筑师的青睐。

descriptions.en: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
descriptions.zh: 高纯度矿物质化合物，因其强度，弹性和耐热性而备受推崇。广泛用于 Tenno 中继站的建造。

descriptions.en:
This living mass can produce weaponized toxins for weaponry.

Location: Clan Research (Bio Lab in the Dojo) and Infested Outbreak Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
此生体聚合物可以制造出可供武器使用的毒素。 

获取地点：生物实验室（氏族道场）和 Infested 爆发奖励

descriptions.en:
These samples could advance our knowledge of biological research.

Location: Eris and Deimos
descriptions.zh:
这些样本有助于使我们的生物研究水平更进一步。

获取地点：阋神星和火卫二。

descriptions.en:
Detonite injectors are the basis for explosive and incendiary weapons.

Location: Clan Research (Chem Lab in the Dojo) and Grineer Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
爆燃喷射器是爆炸和燃烧类武器的基础。

获取地点：化学实验室（氏族道场）和 Grineer 入侵任务奖励

descriptions.en:
Researching the Detonite traces within could advance our weapon technology.

Location: Venus, Earth, Lua, Ceres, Saturn, Sedna, and the Kuva Fortress
descriptions.zh:
对爆燃安瓿内的残留物进行研究，可推动我们的武器技术。

获取地点：金星，地球，月球，谷神星，土星，赛德娜和赤毒要塞。

descriptions.en: A cipher used to decode Corpus intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
descriptions.zh: 一种用来破解Corpus 电脑密码的解码器。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

descriptions.en: A Corpus datamass containing encrypted intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
descriptions.zh: 一个内含加密情报的 Corpus 数据块。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

descriptions.en:
ClanTech weaponized containment field to contain superheated substances.

Location: Clan Research (Energy Lab in the Dojo) and Corpus Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
氏族技术人员利用能量包围力场控制高热能物质以利于武器化。

获取地点：（道场中）能源实验室的氏族研究和 Corpus 入侵任务奖励

descriptions.en:
This destroyed Fieldron could further research into super-heated containment fields.

Location: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune, and Pluto
descriptions.zh:
借由损坏的电磁力场装置可促进有关高热能物质能量包围力场方面的研究。

获取地点：金星，火星，木星，欧罗巴，海王星和冥王星。

descriptions.en: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
descriptions.zh: 在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！

descriptions.en: Celebrate the release of Warframe: 1999 with this poster of the On-lyne boys and their Technocyte Coda counterparts.
descriptions.zh: 通过这张线上时代男孩和他们对应的科技细胞终幕者的海报来庆祝《Warframe：1999》的发布。

descriptions.en: The cover of the Warframe: 1999 graphica with art by TBG Karu
descriptions.zh: 《Warframe：1999》漫画图像的封面，由 TBG Karu 绘制

descriptions.en: Grace your walls with this poster promoting Temple and the Rippers’s fateful 1999 tour.
descriptions.zh: 用这张宣传 Temple 和撕裂者 1999 年重要巡演的海报，来装饰你的墙壁吧。

names.en: Temple and the Rippers Tour Poster
names.zh: Temple 和撕裂者巡演海报

descriptions.en: Show your love for Zeke, Drillbit, DJ Rom, Hardrive and Packet with this lovingly arranged collection of On-lyne fold-out posters. Who is your favorite?
descriptions.zh: 用这套精心编排的线上时代折叠海报来表达你对兹克、钻头小子、打碟王、硬盘和数据使者的喜爱。谁是你最喜欢的？

descriptions.en: A commemorative poster.
descriptions.zh: 一份纪念海报。

descriptions.en: A commemorative poster.
descriptions.zh: 一份纪念海报。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Stalker's Acolyte, Misery.
descriptions.zh: 一小座追猎者追随者苦难摇头娃娃

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Stalker's Acolyte, Torment.
descriptions.zh: 一小座追猎者追随者折磨摇头娃娃

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Stalker's Acolyte, Violence.
descriptions.zh: 一小座追猎者的追随者，暴力摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Stalker's Acolyte, Malice.
descriptions.zh: 一小座追猎者的追随者，怨恨摇头娃娃

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Stalker's Acolyte, Mania.
descriptions.zh: 一小座追猎者追随者躁狂摇头娃娃

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Stalker's Acolyte, Angst.
descriptions.zh: 一小座追猎者追随者焦虑摇头娃娃

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Alad V.
descriptions.zh: 一小座阿拉德 V 摇头娃娃

names.zh: 阿拉德 V 摇头娃娃

descriptions.en: A unique display, featuring two sides of Albrecht Entrati. Created by Community Artist Shiro_kosh_a.
descriptions.zh: 这个独特的展示图，展现了阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的两面。由社区艺术家 Shiro_kosh_a 创作。

names.zh: 英择谛社区融合展示图

descriptions.en: Decorate your space with a portrait of the mysterious Albrecht Entrati.
descriptions.zh: 用神秘的阿尔布雷希特·英择谛肖像装点你的空间。

names.zh: 阿尔布雷希特 1999 展示图

descriptions.en: Decorate the Orbiter with this figurine of an ancient warrior, made from the very finest green polyethylene. Circa 1999.
descriptions.zh: 用这尊古代武士雕像来装饰你的轨道飞行器，雕像由最优质的绿色聚乙烯制成。时刻梦回《1999》。

descriptions.en: Your own Stuffie Buddy astronaut, ready for adventures in outer space!
descriptions.zh: 属于你的毛绒小伙伴宇航员，随时准备好去外太空冒险！

descriptions.en: Commemorate the Lua landings with this fun, robust rocketship. Batteries not included.
descriptions.zh: 用这艘有趣、坚固的火箭来纪念月球登陆。不含电池。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of the Ambulas.
descriptions.zh: 一小座智踱恐鸟摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: A small icon of the Arbiters Hexis to place in your Orbiter.

descriptions.en: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
descriptions.zh: 不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。

descriptions.en: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
descriptions.zh: 财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。

descriptions.en: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
descriptions.zh: 嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。

descriptions.en: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
descriptions.zh: 欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。

descriptions.en: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
descriptions.zh: 当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。

descriptions.en: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
descriptions.zh: 知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。

descriptions.en: Money begets money.
descriptions.zh: 钱生钱。

descriptions.en: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
descriptions.zh: 给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。

descriptions.en: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
descriptions.zh: 避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。

descriptions.en: Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
descriptions.zh: 当你能满足欲望，他人会，蜂拥追随。

descriptions.en: We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.
descriptions.zh: 我们是欲望的化身。我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们，是， Corpus。

descriptions.en: A Zenith Granum Crown replica for your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 一个给轨道飞行器的顶级格拉努硬币复制品。

descriptions.zh: 一个给轨道飞行器的格拉努硬币复制品。

descriptions.zh: 一个给轨道飞行器的范本格拉努硬币复制品。

descriptions.en: A miniature of a Corpus shrine said to represent the hand of their Founder.
descriptions.zh: 微型 Corpus 神龛，据说代表着他们创始人的手。

descriptions.en: Long before the Orokin Era, there was a sharpshooter who would become legend. This decoration honors Cyte-09's Protoframe, Quincy.
descriptions.zh: 早在奥罗金时代之前，就有一位日后成为传奇的神枪手。这个装饰是为了纪念 Cyte-09 的原型战甲——昆西。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Darvo.

descriptions.zh: 由'祖母'亲手制作，这款令人毛骨悚然的饰物讲述了一个有关纳贝流士之夜的特殊故事。找个舒服的姿势，然后听它慢慢道来……

descriptions.en: You can almost feel the beast growling, beckoning you closer. Place it in a spot of honor, settle in, and listen to the story its gaze seems ready to tell.
descriptions.zh: 你几乎能感觉到那野兽在咆哮，在召唤你走近。把它放在一个荣誉之地，静坐下来，聆听它目光中准备诉说的故事。

descriptions.en: This delicate Entrati design's slender metal arm holds a subtle blue flame in a state of perfect equipoise.
descriptions.zh: 这件英择谛精巧设计的细长金属臂，以一种完美平衡的状态，托举着一团微妙的蓝色火焰。

descriptions.en: Natural infested forms combine in an eye-catching piece that recalls the singular landscape of Deimos.
descriptions.zh: 感染的自然形态融合在一件夺目的作品内，让人联想到火卫二的独特景观。

descriptions.en: Add the perfect infested highlight to any room with this expertly cast decorative piece.
descriptions.zh: 通过这件专业铸造的装饰品来为任意房间增添完美的感染特色。

descriptions.en: Sneak in this stand-out accent piece to give your ship’s interior a unique flair.
descriptions.zh: 悄然拿出这件杰出的装饰品，来为你的飞船内部带来一丝独特的风格。

descriptions.en: This insectoid plant’s hardy disposition makes it a great, low-maintenance addition to any space.
descriptions.zh: 这种类昆虫植物的顽强性格，使其对任意空间来说都是一种绝佳的易养护的装饰品。

descriptions.en: Beauty and strangeness blend in this distinctive tendrilled houseplant.
descriptions.zh: 集美丽与珍奇为一身的独特卷须室内植物。

descriptions.en: This bioluminescent plant is sure to brighten up any dark corner in your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 这种生物发光植物一定会照亮你轨道飞行器中的任何黑暗角落。

descriptions.en: The functional elegance of Orokin design makes this a versatile piece for storage or display.
descriptions.zh: 源自奥罗金设计的优雅实用性，使其成为可用作储存或展示的多功能工艺品。

descriptions.en: Evoking the timeless classicism of the Orokin era, the Kybus makes a great base or table.
descriptions.zh: 唤起奥罗金时代永恒的古典主义，绘玉台是一个很不错的底座或桌子。

descriptions.en: With its antiqued metal and delicate gold accents, this Orokin floor piece adds grace and style to any room.
descriptions.zh: 通过使用古式金属和精致的金色装饰，这件奥罗金地面装饰可以为任意房间增添典雅和格调。

descriptions.en: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
descriptions.zh: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

descriptions.en: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
descriptions.zh: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

descriptions.en: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
descriptions.zh: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

descriptions.en: Give your dirty floors Hell and your Orbiter some hardcore edge.
descriptions.zh: 让你的脏地板见识地狱般的清洁，为你的轨道飞行器增添硬核风格。

descriptions.en: We've got two words for ya: Soak it!
descriptions.zh: 两个字：湿透！

descriptions.en: Ride the waves with Yareli. Beverage not included.
descriptions.zh: 和 Yareli 一起乘风破浪。饮料不包含在内。

descriptions.en: This statue is strangely familiar.
descriptions.zh: 这座雕像出奇地熟悉。

descriptions.en: A claret with notes of golden sunlight. The Leverian’s history of the Warframe Ash brings into question whether blood runs thicker than fine wine.
descriptions.zh: 散发着金色阳光气息的红葡萄酒。Ash 在莱弗博物馆的历史不由让人质疑鲜血是否比红酒更加浓郁。

names.zh: 德纳斯的陈年红葡萄酒

descriptions.en: A long barrel to fill with oil, water, and other materials artisans might find useful.
descriptions.zh: 一个高桶，用来装油、水和其他工匠觉得可能有用的材料。

descriptions.en: A short barrel to fill with oil, water, and other materials artisans might find useful.
descriptions.zh: 一个矮桶，用来装油、水和其他工匠觉得可能有用的材料。

descriptions.en: A discreet way to have a sip while attending any formal event.
descriptions.zh: 一个瓶子，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中描述的市民生活。

descriptions.en: The ideal vessel for any Tammherd who enjoys a hot or cold drink on the job.
descriptions.zh: 一个保温瓶，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中描述的市民生活。

descriptions.en: Sip from this mug as you assess what the morning sky has in store.
descriptions.zh: 一个杯子，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中描述的市民生活。

descriptions.en: Brighten your space with sunny Duviri florals.
descriptions.zh: 用阳光明媚的双衍王境花卉点亮你的居所。

descriptions.en: Brighten your space with rosy Duviri florals.
descriptions.zh: 用娇艳如玫瑰的双衍王境花卉点亮你的居所。

descriptions.en: Brighten your space with elegant Duviri florals.
descriptions.zh: 用高雅的双衍王境花卉点亮你的居所。

descriptions.en: A short green pot of soil artisans might find useful.
descriptions.zh: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个矮绿色工匠盆。

descriptions.en: A tall green pot of soil artisans might find useful.
descriptions.zh: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个高绿色工匠盆。

descriptions.en: A wide green pot of soil artisans might find useful.
descriptions.zh: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个宽绿色工匠盆。

descriptions.en: A tall white pot of soil artisans might find useful.
descriptions.zh: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个高白色工匠盆。

descriptions.en: A wide white pot of soil artisans might find useful.
descriptions.zh: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个宽白色工匠盆。

descriptions.en: A throne inspired by descriptions of the king's palace in Tales of Duviri.
descriptions.zh: 一个王座，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中对王宫的描述。

descriptions.en: An ingenious device for arithmetic. Used to keep track of a shopkeeper’s sales, a kingdom’s wealth, or the seemingly endless spiral of time.
descriptions.zh: 一个精巧的算术装置。用来记录店主的销售、王境的财富，或者看似无穷无尽的时间螺旋。

descriptions.en: Duviri citizens are expected to keep clean at all times, in case Thrax’s gaze should fall upon them.
descriptions.zh: 双衍王境的公民必须时刻保持干净，以防士魂大帝的目光落在他们身上。

descriptions.en: A replica of the cryptic monument that overshadows the many graves of Duviri.
descriptions.zh: 掩盖双衍王境众多坟墓的神秘墓碑复制品。

descriptions.en: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine's performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.
descriptions.zh: 非常适合欣赏蓬蓬士君的表演。有缓冲，以避免久坐的麻木不适。

descriptions.en: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.
descriptions.zh: 如果双衍王境的民选政府真实存在，那么一定用的是这种风格的座椅。

descriptions.en: Standard fodder for the Kaithes of Duviri, doubling as a humble bed for the weary laborer.
descriptions.zh: 双衍王境里绝灵骥的标准饲料，同时也是疲惫工人的简陋床铺。

descriptions.en: Even the lowest Duviri citizen may need to reach a high spot from time to time.
descriptions.zh: 即使是最底层的双衍王境公民，时不时也需要到达一些高度。

descriptions.en: A sturdy table on which to enjoy the nutritious dole of simple grains which Thrax’s generosity has blessed you with.
descriptions.zh: 一张坚固的桌子，在上面你可以享受由士魂大帝慷慨赐予的营养丰富的简单谷物。

descriptions.en: Ideal for lecturing, preaching, or reading magnificent poetic compositions to a crowd who does not understand or appreciate them.
descriptions.zh: 是向不理解或不懂得欣赏的凡夫俗子们演讲、布教或诵读宏伟的诗歌作品的理想选择。

descriptions.en: Used to weigh out meager, everyday goods by meager, everyday merchants.
descriptions.zh: 用来给普通商人称量微不足道的日常物品。

descriptions.en: For those times when turning into an Orowyrm is not an option.
descriptions.zh: 适用于无法变成奥金魇龙的时候。

descriptions.en: Thrax has, grudgingly, allowed his citizens the use of these screens for the preservation of personal modesty. There are some places where even his exalted eyes have no business peering.
descriptions.zh: 士魂大帝勉强允许他的公民使用这些屏风来维护个人的隐私。有些地方即使是他那双尊贵的眼睛也无权窥视。

descriptions.en: Draft and redraft endless bureaucratic scrolls with this fine Duviri desk.
descriptions.zh: 用这张精美的双衍王境书桌，反复起草没完没了的官僚文书。

descriptions.en: An elegant depiction of the fabled Orowyrm.
descriptions.zh: 优雅地描绘了传说中的奥金魇龙。

names.zh: 奥金魇龙的圣所展示图

descriptions.en: Neci Rusalka’s distinctive Scaldra hat, received as part of a mysterious communication.
descriptions.zh: 鲁莎卡少校独特的炽蛇军帽，在一次神秘通信中获得。

names.zh: 鲁莎卡少校的帽子纪念品

descriptions.en: Medals for valor awarded to Neci Rusalka, received as part of a mysterious communication.
descriptions.zh: 内奇·鲁莎卡的英勇勋章，在一次神秘通信中获得。

names.zh: 鲁莎卡少校的勋章纪念品

descriptions.en: A hero on the back of a loyal Kaithe, as described in the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
descriptions.zh: 一位英雄骑乘着忠诚的绝灵骥，就像《双衍王境故事集》中描绘的那样。

names.zh: 双衍王境的英雄展示图

descriptions.en: The Watchful Paragrimm chooses to watch over those with keen minds.
descriptions.zh: 警惕的幽幽鹰选择守望那些思维敏锐的人。

descriptions.en: An instructive storybook by Euleria Entrati.
descriptions.zh: 由欧拉瑞娅·英择谛写的一本具有教育意义的故事书。

descriptions.en: An ornate display, created by Sillfix.
descriptions.zh: 一张华丽的展示图，由 Sillfix 创作。

descriptions.en: In Arbitrations, where death’s shadow looms, life’s fire burns brightest. This light sculpture is a tribute to that survival.
descriptions.zh: 在仲裁之中，死亡阴影隐现之处，生命之火燃得最旺。这座光的雕塑致敬了那种求生的精神。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Ember.
descriptions.zh: 一小座 Ember 摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Ember Prime.
descriptions.zh: 一小座 Ember Prime 摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Ember Vermillion.
descriptions.zh: 一小座 Ember 朱红摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: Decorate your Orbiter with this Empyrean-themed poster.
descriptions.zh: 用九重天主题的海报装饰你的轨道飞行器。

descriptions.en: A gilded chair upholstered with the finest silk. The perfect spot to sit and contemplate the Universe and beyond.
descriptions.zh: 一把镀金的椅子，上面铺着上好的丝绸。这是坐下来沉思宇宙和外宇宙的绝佳位置。

descriptions.en: An unorthodox chair of Albrecht Entrati’s own design.
descriptions.zh: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛自己设计的一把另类椅子。

descriptions.en: Curl up on the same chaise lounge that Albrecht Entrati’s favorite pet, Kalymos, once did.
descriptions.zh: 蜷缩在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛最喜欢的宠物卡利莫斯曾经呆过的躺椅上。

descriptions.en: Cast an aura of sophistication with this Entrati Chandelier.
descriptions.zh: 用这款英择谛吊灯营造出精致的氛围。

descriptions.en: An elegant Candelabra that once adorned the secret laboratories of Albrecht Entrati.
descriptions.zh: 曾经装饰过阿尔布雷希特·英择谛秘密实验室的优雅烛台。

descriptions.en: A grand, gilded Candelabra originally found in the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s labs.
descriptions.zh: 最初在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛实验室深处发现的宏伟镀金烛台。

descriptions.en: Create a timeless look with this wall sconce, plucked from the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s Deimos laboratory.
descriptions.zh: 这款壁灯取自阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的火卫二实验室深处，打造出永恒的外观。

descriptions.en: Relax and ponder the unknown with this Entrati Settee.
descriptions.zh: 使用这款英择谛沙发椅放松并思考未知。

descriptions.en: A deeply complex machine of unknown function.
descriptions.zh: 功能未知、极其复杂的机器。

descriptions.en: Designed and built by Albrecht Entrati, the precise purpose of this machine is as much of an enigma as the man himself.
descriptions.zh: 这台机器由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计和制造，其确切用途与他本人一样是个谜。

descriptions.en: Used by Albrecht Entrati to chart a temporal path to eras unknown.
descriptions.zh: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛用此绘制通向未知时代的时间路径。

descriptions.en: Relax, as Albrecht Entrati must have, with this timeless ottoman.
descriptions.zh: 踏上这款经久不衰的脚凳放松身心，就像阿尔布雷希特·英择谛所做的一样。

descriptions.en: A sophisticated stool. Perfect for lab work and deep concentration.
descriptions.zh: 一把精致的凳子。非常适合实验室工作和深度专注。

descriptions.en: A watchful eye for the Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 轨道飞行器的警觉之眼。

descriptions.en: A Paragrimm ascends from Noctua's pages to accompany you in your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 一只幽幽鹰从夜枭的书页中升起，在轨道飞行器中陪伴你。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Equinox.
descriptions.zh: 一小座 Equinox 摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: Erra's gaze brings his hypnotic message.
descriptions.zh: Erra 的目光带来了他的催眠信息。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Erra.
descriptions.zh: 一小座 Erra 摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: A memory of the lovers, Belric and Rania, preserved in crystal.
descriptions.zh: 封存在水晶中的贝里克和拉尼娅，这对恋人的记忆。

descriptions.en: Celebrate Pride with this radiant Orbiter decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款闪耀的轨道飞行器装饰来庆祝骄傲月。

descriptions.en: A golden image of Executor Nitokh, whose arbitrary nature and perverse appetites were legendary even among the Seven.
descriptions.zh: 执行者尼托的金像，其专横暴虐与变态嗜好即便在七人众中也是十分出名。

descriptions.en: Celebrate Star Days with this radiant Orbiter decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款闪耀的轨道飞行器装饰来庆祝星日。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of an Executioner from Tactical Alert: Dog Days.
descriptions.zh: 一小座来自战术警报：三伏天中的行刑者摇头娃娃。

names.zh: 三伏天行刑者 Zura 摇头娃娃

names.zh: 三伏天行刑者加雷什摇头娃娃

descriptions.zh: 一小座来自战术警报：三伏天中的行刑者摇头娃娃。

descriptions.zh: 用于表达对心上人那种极其平常且克制的感情。微弱的艾弗旺痕迹暗示，这位艺术家可能有一只机械手。

descriptions.en: A small Jack O'Naut Statue.
descriptions.zh: 一小座南瓜巨兽雕像。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of the Jackal.
descriptions.zh: 一小座豺狼摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: Be not afraid with Jade's gaze in your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 不必害怕 Jade 在轨道飞行器中注视的目光。

descriptions.en: Feathers of memory, lovingly collected. The gift of self, immortalized in motes of steadfast light.
descriptions.zh: 记忆之羽，悉心珍藏。献予自己的礼物，化作永恒的微光，永垂不朽。

descriptions.en: Invite the spirits of the Otherworld into your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 邀请异世界的灵魂进入你的轨道飞行器。

descriptions.en: This display celebrates the best of both worlds, and the worst of each. United or divided, they are two sides of the same whole.
descriptions.zh: 这个展示图既展现了两种文化的优点，也揭露了它们的缺点。无论团结还是分裂，它们都是同一个整体的两面。

descriptions.en: This display honors Orion, the burning heart. Schooled in vengeance, the only love he knows is death.
descriptions.zh: 这个展示图是为了纪念 Orion，他拥有一颗燃烧的心。他从小就被复仇所熏陶，他唯一懂得的爱就是死亡。

descriptions.en: This display honors Sirius, the lonely star. Raised in shadow. Trained with dignity.
descriptions.zh: 这个展示图在致敬 Sirius，一颗孤独的星。他在阴影中成长，在尊严中成长。

descriptions.en: A portrait of the Stalker forging his lonely path.
descriptions.zh: 追猎者孤独地踏上征程的肖像。

descriptions.en: An embrace of lovers, divided by war.
descriptions.zh: 紧密相拥的恋人，他们在战争中被拆散。

descriptions.en: A portrait of the Stalker: once a dark avenger, now a devoted father.
descriptions.zh: 追猎者的肖像：曾是黑暗的复仇者，现在是一位尽职的父亲。

descriptions.en: Become a student of Javi. This evolution scrawling is based on Drusus Leverian's records of Lavos.
descriptions.zh: 成为哈维的学生。这张进化涂鸦源于德枢·莱弗对 Lavos 的记录。

descriptions.en: This mural cycles through four elegant portraits of the wolves that once guarded Lua: Dynar the shadowed, Raksh the defender, Lycath the stalwart, and Ulfrun the fierce.
descriptions.zh: 这幅壁画循环展示了四张曾经守护月球的狼群的优雅肖像：暗影者戴拿、防御者亚克什、顽强的莱卡斯，和凶猛的乌尔佛伦。

descriptions.zh: 平底编织盘上堆满了来自希图斯市场的红色香料。

descriptions.en: A sign, daubed with blue pigment and crafted from reclaimed driftwood. A common feature of the streets and byways of Cetus.
descriptions.zh: 一个标牌，用蓝色颜料涂抹，由回收来的浮木制成。是希图斯街道和小巷中常见之物。

descriptions.zh: 使用 Corpus 最先进的卫生科技来维持一尘不染的轨道飞行器环境。

descriptions.en: This drone eradicates dust and dirt with quiet efficiency.
descriptions.zh: 这款无人机能够安静高效地清除灰尘和污垢。

descriptions.en: Reinvented from the ground up, the Ki'Teer Domestik is a revolution in sanitation and style.
descriptions.zh: 经过了彻头彻尾的改造，Ki'Teer 内务无人机在环境卫生和样式风格领域掀起了一场革命。

descriptions.en: All the cleaning style of the original Ki'Teer Domestik, in a fresh, elegant new color.
descriptions.zh: 延续了原版 Ki'teer 内务无人机的经典清洁风格，以全新清新优雅的配色呈现。

descriptions.zh: 无论你是平民还是国王，这款勤奋的无人机都会让你的家保持一尘不染。

descriptions.zh: Grineer 清洁技术：并不比 Corpus 低效，只不过存在感要强得多。

descriptions.zh: 一个从你的任务中偷跑出来的感染者，现在正满足地在你的轨道飞行器上游荡。

descriptions.en: Oraxia’s creeping crawlers are pleased to make the Orbiter their hunting ground.
descriptions.zh: Oraxia 的爬行蜘蛛很高兴将轨道飞行器作为它们的狩猎场。

descriptions.en: A still-living fragment torn free from one of the feared Eidolons that stalk the plains beyond Cetus.
descriptions.zh: 从徘徊在希图斯之外的可怕夜灵身上撕下，仍然活动的碎片。

descriptions.en: A single boot, possibly of Grineer design, pulled from one of the ponds that dot the Eidolon Plains. Smells of Gulper and pondscum.
descriptions.zh: 一只靴子，可能是 Grineer 设计，从遍布夜灵平野的某个池塘中钓出。闻起来有股囊咽鱼和绿藻的气味。

descriptions.en: It is believed that Onkko protected the coffer's contents with a glass shatter lock.
descriptions.zh: 据信昂克用一把玻璃做的碎裂锁保护了保险箱中的东西。

descriptions.en: This antique Orokin string instrument once belonged to a great Dax. The ancient ballad, 'Smiles from Juran,' is one of the few known examples of music composed for this instrument. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
descriptions.zh: 这个古老的奥罗金弦乐器曾经属于一个伟大的禁卫。古老的民谣《朱兰笑》，是为这种乐器创作的为数不多的已知乐曲之一。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。

descriptions.en: Shape intricate melodies with this geometric shawzin.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款几何状的三线琴来编织复杂的旋律。

descriptions.en: Compose ballads of old threats risen anew, with this shawzin.
descriptions.zh: 用这把三线琴谱写旧时威胁再次崛起的民谣。

descriptions.zh: 合一众信徒用来赞美 Ballas 的金色三线琴。

descriptions.en: The cooperative nature of this Necramite can be attributed to its omission from security protocols, and to the (almost) total absence of the Indifference from the Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 这种殁世微灵的合作性质可以归因于它被排除在安全协议之外，以及轨道飞行器几乎完全没有虚空无情之物的存在。

descriptions.en: Adopt one of Nokko's adorable Sprodlings to bounce around the orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 领养 Nokko 的一只可爱菌宝，让它在轨道飞行器周围蹦蹦跳跳。

descriptions.en: Adorn your Orbiter with this decoration representing the Nightwave Landing Craft.
descriptions.zh: 用这个代表午夜电波登陆艇的装饰来点缀你的飞行器。

descriptions.zh: 用这个古老型号的 Corpus 储物柜的微型复制品来装饰轨道飞行器。

descriptions.zh: 一个指挥官用来控制其网络权限的开关。

descriptions.en: A stone marker, miraculously preserved from the Orokin era, polished smooth by time and accented with tooled gold.
descriptions.zh: 一个石头记号，奇迹般地从奥罗金时代保存下来，被时光打磨抛光，并被金子手工点缀。

descriptions.en: A spotlight constructed by the Ostron people.
descriptions.zh: 一盏由 Ostron 人建造的聚光灯。

descriptions.en: An Infested stowaway from one of your Missions, now content to wander your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 一个从你的任务中偷跑出来的感染者，现在正满足地在你的轨道飞行器上游荡。

descriptions.en: Illumination, crafted by Ostron glassworkers, fashioned and gilded to aesthetic perfection.
descriptions.zh: 照明物，由 Ostron 玻璃工人制作，工艺和镀金都体现了极致的审美。

descriptions.en: A bird of prey to accompany you aboard the Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 轨道飞行器中的猛禽伴侣。

descriptions.en: A small sample of sacred Temple flesh, iconic export of Cetus.
descriptions.zh: 一小块神殿肉的样本，希图斯的标志性出口品。

descriptions.en: One of Cetus' signature sights, in miniature.
descriptions.zh: 缩小的希图斯标志性景象之一。

descriptions.en: Turquoise glass suspended in a handmade gilded basket, filled with bioluminescence.
descriptions.zh: 青绿色的玻璃悬挂在手工制作的镀金篮子中，注有生物冷光物质。

descriptions.en: A small rodent of Earthly origin to keep you company aboard the Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 一种来自地球的小型啮齿类，可以在轨道飞行器中伴随你。

descriptions.en: Personalize your quarters with this unique rug.
descriptions.zh: 用这个独特的毯子来个性化你的个人房间。

descriptions.zh: 一种有蓝色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子

descriptions.en: A glass carving depicting the colossal Thousand-Year Fish of Ostron legend.
descriptions.zh: 一个描绘着 Ostron 传奇的巨大千年灵鱼的玻璃雕刻。

descriptions.en: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

descriptions.en: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.

descriptions.en: Corpus-produced posters and signboards reminding Solaris workers of rights and safety protocols. Report nonconformists! Life is Profit, Profit is Life!
descriptions.zh: 由 Corpus 出产的海报及布告板，提醒 Solaris 工人的权利及安全措施。一律举报不遵奉者！人生是利益，利益就是人生！

descriptions.en: A single, warm Sentient core decoration for your orbiter - still illuminated by a shred of the power it once commanded.
descriptions.zh: 一颗温暖的 Sentient 核心装饰，借由过去所拥有的力量仍在发光。

names.zh: 发光的 Sentient 核心装饰

descriptions.en: Elite audiences appreciate the Courtly Shawzin’s elegant ornamentation.
descriptions.zh: 精英阶层观众普遍欣赏典雅三线琴那优雅的装饰。

descriptions.en: A creative soul rings out with each strum of the Lonesome Shawzin.
descriptions.zh: 孤寂三线琴的每一次弹奏都会响起一个创造性的灵魂。

descriptions.en: Long ago this Shawzin was played to entertain the Orokin court. Now its enduring music shall celebrate your victories.
descriptions.zh: 很久以前，这把三线琴是奥罗金宫廷的御用乐器。而现在，它那悠扬的曲调，将为你的胜利而奏响。

descriptions.en: For some favored Tenno, Flare's infested guitar has consented to be played like any other instrument. Handle with respect - and caution.
descriptions.zh: 对于某些受青睐的 Tenno 来说，弗莱尔的感染吉他已同意像其他乐器一样被演奏。请怀着敬意——并小心使用。

descriptions.en: A familiar sound with a distinctive new look.
descriptions.zh: 一个熟悉的声音配上一款与众不同的新外观。

descriptions.en: This instrument belonged to a much-loved member of the Holdfasts, who would often cheer up her companions with it.
descriptions.zh: 这件乐器曾属于坚守者中一位深受喜爱的成员，她经常会弹奏它来鼓舞同伴。

descriptions.en: Kira played her shawzin to uplift the spirits of Zariman crewmembers. Her song and her memory live on in the Void.
descriptions.zh: 吉拉演奏她的三线琴来振奋扎里曼船员的精神。她的歌声和记忆永存于虚空之中。

descriptions.en: Hunter, behold the rewards of your work in Synthesis. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 猎者，看看你结合仪式的成果吧。这是一个可以装点你轨道飞行器的失效的 Simaris 控制台装饰。

names.zh: Simaris 声望奖励复刻控制台

descriptions.en: In Synthesis all things may be known, Hunter. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 在结合仪式中所有的东西或许都是已知的，猎者。这是一个可以装点你轨道飞行器的失效的 Simaris 控制台装饰。

descriptions.en: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.

descriptions.en: The exalted armaments of Styanax Prime, ready for place of pride in your Orbiter.

names.zh: 豪勇 & 崇敬 Prime 装饰

descriptions.en: You will honor Styanax when you display these cherished armaments.
descriptions.zh: 通过展示这些珍贵的军备来向 Styanax 致敬。

descriptions.en: Display this statue in honor of Ulfrun's strength.

descriptions.en: When DJ RoM speaks, the world tunes in! And this reporter was no exception. The whole crew from On-lyne nodded along as DJ said, 'We became a group because we share a love for music.' Talk about squad goals!
